en.t: Robert II of France names his son Henry I as junior King of the Franks
en.s: Robert II (c. 972 – 20 July 1031), called the Pious (French: le Pieux) or the Wise (French: le Sage), was king of the Franks from 996 to 1031, the second from the Capetian dynasty. Crowned junior king in 987, he assisted his father on military matters (notably during the two sieges of Laon, in 988 and 991).

zh.t: 法国国王罗贝尔二世任命其子亨利一世为法兰克共治国王
zh.s: 罗贝尔二世（约972年—1031年7月20日），称“虔诚者”（法语：le Pieux）或“智者”（法语：le Sage），是996年至1031年的法兰克国王，也是卡佩王朝第二位国王。他于987年加冕为共治国王，并协助父亲处理军事事务，尤其参与了988年和991年对拉昂的两次围城战。

en.s: The siege of Nicaea was the first major battle of the First Crusade, taking place from 14 May to 19 June 1097. The city was under the control of the Seljuk Turks who opted to surrender to the Byzantines in fear of the Crusaders breaking into the city. The siege was followed by the Battle of Dorylaeum and the Siege of Antioch, all taking place in modern Turkey.

zh.s: 尼西亚围城战是第一次十字军东征的首场重大战役，始于1097年5月14日，持续至6月19日。尼西亚当时由塞尔柱突厥人控制；他们担心十字军攻入城内，选择向拜占庭人投降。此后发生了多里留姆战役和安条克围城战，地点都在今天的土耳其境内。

en.s: The Battle of Down, also known as the battle of Drumderg (Irish: Druim Dearg) took place on or about 14 May 1260 near Downpatrick, in modern-day County Down, Northern Ireland. A Gaelic alliance led by Brian O'Neill (High-King of Ireland) and Hugh O'Connor were defeated by the English. The forces of Brian O'Neill had been raiding the Anglo-Irish Earldom of Ulster after 1257 in an attempt to assert their independence and form a coalition of the Irish against the English.

zh.s: 唐恩战役又称德鲁姆德格战役，于1260年5月14日前后在今北爱尔兰唐帕特里克附近发生。布赖恩·奥尼尔（爱尔兰至高王）和休·奥康纳率领盖尔人联盟，与英格兰军队交战并战败。1257年后，布赖恩·奥尼尔的部队曾袭击英裔爱尔兰人统治的阿尔斯特伯爵领，试图争取独立并联合爱尔兰各方对抗英格兰。

en.s: The Battle of Lewes was one of two main battles of the conflict known as the Second Barons' War. It took place at Lewes in Sussex, on 14 May 1264. It marked the high point of the career of Simon de Montfort, 6th Earl of Leicester, and made him the "uncrowned King of England". Henry III left the safety of Lewes Castle and St. Pancras Priory to engage the Barons in battle and was initially successful, his son Prince Edward routing part of the baronial army with a cavalry charge. However Edward pursued his quarry off the battlefield and left Henry's men exposed.

zh.s: 刘易斯战役是第二次男爵战争中的两场主要战役之一，于1264年5月14日在苏塞克斯的刘易斯发生。这场战役使莱斯特伯爵西蒙·德·蒙福特的声望达到顶峰，他也因此被称为“未加冕的英格兰国王”。亨利三世离开刘易斯城堡和圣潘克拉斯修道院的安全地带，与男爵军交战，起初占据上风。他的儿子爱德华王子率骑兵冲锋，击溃了男爵军的一部分，但随后追击对手离开战场，使亨利的部队暴露在敌军面前。

en.s: The first siege of Krujë (Albanian: Rrethimi i parë i Krujës) occurred in 1450 when an Ottoman army led by Sultan Murad II and his crown prince Mehmed II tried to besiege the Albanian town of Krujë. The League of Lezhë, led by Skanderbeg, experienced low morale after losing Svetigrad and Berat between 1448 and 1450.

zh.s: 1450年，穆拉德二世苏丹及其王储穆罕默德二世率领奥斯曼军队围攻阿尔巴尼亚城镇克鲁亚。斯坎德培领导的莱日联盟在1448年至1450年间失去斯韦蒂格拉德和培拉特后，士气低落。

en.s: The Stafford and Lovell rebellion was the first armed uprising against King Henry VII after he won the crown at the Battle of Bosworth in 1485. The uprising was led by Francis Lovell, Viscount Lovell, along with Sir Humphrey Stafford and Thomas Stafford, brothers from Grafton, Worcestershire. The uprising occurred during Eastertime 1486.

zh.t: 斯塔福德和洛弗尔叛乱
zh.s: 斯塔福德和洛弗尔叛乱是亨利七世于1485年在博斯沃思战役后登基以来，首次针对他的武装起义。起义由洛弗尔子爵弗朗西斯·洛弗尔，以及来自伍斯特郡格拉夫顿的兄弟汉弗莱·斯塔福德爵士和托马斯·斯塔福德领导，发生于1486年复活节期间。

en.s: The Battle of Agnadello, also known as Vailà, was fought on 14 May 1509 between the army of King Louis XII of France and the Venetian rear-guard elements commanded by Bartolomeo d'Alviano. After a three hour struggle, and after Bartolomeo found himself abandoned by a part of his army, the Venetians were defeated with losses in excess of 4,000 men. Louis then occupied the rest of Lombardy.

zh.s: 阿尼亚德洛战役又称瓦伊拉战役，于1509年5月14日爆发。路易十二国王率领的法军与巴托洛梅奥·达尔维亚诺指挥的威尼斯后卫部队交战。战斗持续3小时后，达尔维亚诺发现部分部队已离开，威尼斯军队最终战败，损失超过4,000人。路易随后占领了伦巴第其余地区。

en.s: The Battle of Djerba (Turkish: Cerbe Deniz Muharebesi, Arabic: معركة جربة) took place in May 1560 near the island of Djerba, Tunisia. The Ottomans under Piali Pasha's command overwhelmed a large joint Christian alliance fleet, composed chiefly of Spanish, Papal, Genoese, Maltese, and Neapolitan forces. The allies lost 27 galleys and some smaller vessels as well as the fortified island of Djerba.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 杰尔巴海战（土耳其语：Cerbe Deniz Muharebesi；阿拉伯语：معركة جربة）于1560年5月在突尼斯杰尔巴岛附近爆发。皮亚莱帕夏指挥的奥斯曼军队击溃了一支基督教国家联合舰队，参战方主要来自西班牙、教宗国、热那亚、马耳他和那不勒斯。联军损失27艘桨帆船和若干小型船只，也失去了设防的杰尔巴岛。

en.t: English colonists establish "James Fort", which would become Jamestown, Virginia, the earliest permanent English settlement in the Americas
en.s: The Jamestown settlement in the Colony of Virginia was the first permanent English settlement in the Americas. It was located, in what later became James City County, on the northeast bank of the James River, about 2.5 mi (4 km) southwest of present-day Williamsburg. It was established by the Virginia Company of London as "James Fort" on May 4, 1607 O.S. (May 14, 1607 N.S.).

zh.t: 英国殖民者建立詹姆斯堡，后来发展为詹姆斯敦
zh.s: 弗吉尼亚殖民地的詹姆斯敦是美洲第一个永久性英国殖民地，位于后来成立的詹姆斯城郡境内，詹姆斯河东北岸，距今威廉斯堡西南约2.5英里（4公里）。伦敦弗吉尼亚公司于1607年5月4日旧历（1607年5月14日新历）在此建立“詹姆斯堡”。

en.t: The Protestant Union, a coalition of Protestant German states, is founded to defend the rights, land and safety of each member against the Catholic Church and Catholic German states
en.s: The Protestant Union (German: Protestantische Union), also known as the Evangelical Union, Union of Auhausen, German Union or the Protestant Action Party, was a coalition of Protestant German states. It was formed on 14 May 1608 by Frederick IV, Elector Palatine in order to defend the rights, land and safety of each member. It included both Calvinist and Lutheran states, and dissolved in 1621.

zh.s: 新教联盟（德语：Protestantische Union）也称福音联盟、奥豪森联盟、德意志联盟或新教行动党，是由德意志新教诸邦组成的联盟。1608年5月14日，普法尔茨选侯腓特烈四世成立该联盟，以维护各成员的权利、领土和安全。联盟成员包括加尔文宗和路德宗诸邦，1621年解散。

en.t: Henry IV of France is assassinated by Catholic zealot François Ravaillac, and Louis XIII ascends the throne
en.s: Henry IV (French: Henri IV; 13 December 1553 – 14 May 1610), also known by the epithets Good King Henry (le Bon Roi Henri) or Henry the Great (Henri le Grand), was King of Navarre (as Henry III) from 1572 and King of France from 1589 to 1610. He was the first monarch of France from the House of Bourbon, a cadet branch of the Capetian dynasty.

zh.t: 法王亨利四世遭天主教狂热分子弗朗索瓦·拉瓦亚克刺杀，路易十三继位
zh.s: 亨利四世（法语：Henri IV；1553 年 12 月 13 日—1610 年 5 月 14 日）又称“好人亨利”或“伟大的亨利”，自 1572 年起以亨利三世之名担任纳瓦拉国王，并于 1589 至 1610 年间担任法国国王。他是法国波旁王朝的首位君主；波旁王朝是卡佩王朝的旁支。

en.s: Louis XIV (Louis-Dieudonné; 5 September 1638 – 1 September 1715), known as the "Sun King", was King of France from 14 May 1643 until his death in 1715. He is the longest-reigning monarch in history, reigning for 72 years and 110 days. His reign brought about a golden age in French history, marked by a great expansion of the French colonial empire and a flourishing of French culture throughout Europe.

zh.s: 路易十四（路易-迪厄多内，1638年9月5日—1715年9月1日），人称“太阳王”，自1643年5月14日起担任法国国王，直至1715年去世。他是历史上在位时间最长的君主，在位72年零110天。他的统治为法国带来一个黄金时代，法国殖民帝国大幅扩张，法国文化也在欧洲各地兴盛。

en.s: The Battle of Aberdeen was fought on 14 May 1646 during the Wars of the Three Kingdoms. George, Marquis of Huntly the commander of a Royalist army, defeated a force of Covenanters under the command of Hugh, Lord Montgomerie.

zh.s: 阿伯丁战役于1646年5月14日爆发，是三王国战争的一部分。亨特利侯爵乔治率领保王党军队，击败了休·蒙哥马利勋爵指挥的圣约派部队。

en.s: The siege of Sirhind was fought between the Mughal Empire and Sikh forces in 1710. The Sikhs besieged, stormed, captured, plundered and razed the city of Sirhind after defeating and beheading Wazir Khan in the Battle of Chappar Chiri.

zh.s: 1710年，莫卧儿帝国军队与锡克军队围绕锡尔欣德交战。锡克军在查帕尔奇里战役击败并斩首瓦齐尔汗后，围攻、攻占、洗劫并夷平锡尔欣德城。

en.s: The First Battle of Cape Finisterre (14 May 1747) was waged during the War of the Austrian Succession. It refers to the attack by 14 British ships of the line under Admiral George Anson against a French 30-ship convoy commanded by Admiral de la Jonquière. The French were attempting to protect their merchant ships by using warships with them.

zh.t: 第一次菲尼斯特雷角海战（1747年）
zh.s: 第一次菲尼斯特雷角海战发生于1747年5月14日，是奥地利王位继承战争的一部分。乔治·安森海军上将率领14艘英国战列舰，袭击了德拉容基耶海军上将指挥的30艘法国船队。法国人派军舰护航，以保护商船。

en.s: The Battle off Fairhaven was the first naval engagement of the American Revolutionary War. It took place on May 14, 1775, in Buzzards Bay off Fairhaven, Massachusetts (then part of Dartmouth, Massachusetts) and resulted in Patriot militia retrieving two vessels that had been captured by HMS Falcon. The patriots also captured the 13 man crew of the Royal Navy, the first naval prisoners of the war.

zh.s: 费尔黑文海战是美国独立战争中的第一次海战，发生于1775年5月14日，地点在马萨诸塞州费尔黑文附近的巴泽兹湾（当时该地属于达特茅斯）。爱国者民兵夺回了此前被英国皇家海军“猎鹰号”俘获的两艘船，并俘虏了船上13名皇家海军船员；他们是这场战争中最早被俘的海军人员。

en.s: The Battle of Pine's Bridge (also known as the Massacre at Pines Bridge) was a minor yet exceptionally violent engagement during the American Revolutionary War, near the town of Yorktown, New York, on May 14, 1781. It was one of the largest raids conducted by Loyalist forces into the infamous Neutral Ground of Westchester County and is considered one of the bloodiest small-unit actions of the war.

zh.s: 派恩斯桥战役也称派恩斯桥大屠杀，是美国独立战争期间一场规模不大但异常惨烈的交战，于1781年5月14日在纽约州约克镇附近发生。这是效忠派军队对威彻斯特县著名的中立区发动的最大规模袭击之一，也被认为是这场战争中最血腥的小规模部队战斗之一。

en.s: The 6th United States Congress was the 6th meeting of the legislative branch of the United States federal government, consisting of the Senate and the House of Representatives. It initially met at Congress Hall in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania and then was the first congress to meet in the new Capitol Building in Washington, D.C.. Its term was from March 4, 1799, to March 4, 1801, during the last two years of John Adams's presidency.
en.n: The 6th United States Congress recesses, and the process of moving the Federal government of the United States from Philadelphia to Washington, D.C., begins the following day.

zh.s: 美国第六届国会是美国联邦政府立法部门的第六届会议，由参议院和众议院组成。国会最初在宾夕法尼亚州费城的国会厅开会，之后成为首届在华盛顿特区新建国会大厦开会的国会。本届国会任期为1799年3月4日至1801年3月4日，涵盖约翰·亚当斯总统任期的最后两年。

en.s: The Lewis and Clark Expedition, also known as the Corps of Discovery Expedition, was the United States expedition to cross the newly acquired western portion of the country after the Louisiana Purchase. The Corps of Discovery was a select group of U.S. Army and civilian volunteers under the command of Captain Meriwether Lewis and his close friend Second Lieutenant William Clark. Clark, along with 30 others, set out from Camp Dubois (Camp Wood), Illinois, on May 14, 1804, met Lewis and ten other members of the group in St.

zh.s: 刘易斯与克拉克远征，又称“发现军团远征”，是美国购买路易斯安那后派出的一支探险队，旨在横越新获得的西部领土。发现军团由美国陆军人员和民间志愿者组成，由梅里韦瑟·刘易斯上尉及其好友、威廉·克拉克少尉指挥。1804 年 5 月 14 日，克拉克与另外 30 人从伊利诺伊州杜波依斯营地（伍德营）出发，在密苏里州圣查尔斯与刘易斯及另外 10 名队员会合，随后沿密苏里河逆流而上。

en.s: Battle of Khurbura or Battle of Khudbuda also known as Gorkha-Garhwal War occurred in May 1804 near modern-day village of Dehradun, Khurbura 30.3256°N 78.0267°E / 30.3256; 78.0267. The battle is regarded as the first major attack in the history of Garhwal Kingdom that triggered between Kingdom of Nepal forces and Maharaja Pradyumna Shah, and continued for 13 days until the Garhwal king was defeated.

zh.s: 库尔布拉战役又称库德布达战役或廓尔喀—加瓦尔战争，发生于1804年5月，在今印度北阿坎德邦德拉敦附近的库尔布拉村一带。尼泊尔王国军队与加瓦尔国王普拉迪乌姆·沙阿交战。这场战役被视为加瓦尔王国历史上首次重大袭击，持续13天，最终加瓦尔国王战败。

en.s: The Battle of Alcántara was fought on 14 May 1809 during the Peninsular War. It saw a French division led by Marshal Claude Perrin Victor attack an Anglo-Portuguese force comprising the British Army's Loyal Lusitanian Legion (LLL) and Portuguese militia under Colonel William Mayne. After a three hours skirmish, the French stormed across the Alcántara Bridge and forced the Portuguese to retreat.

zh.s: 阿尔坎塔拉战役于1809年5月14日爆发，是半岛战争的一部分。克洛德·佩兰·维克托元帅率领法军一个师，进攻由英国军队的忠诚卢西塔尼亚军团和葡萄牙民兵组成的英葡联军，联军由威廉·梅恩上校指挥。经过三小时的交战，法军攻过阿尔坎塔拉桥，迫使葡军撤退。

en.s: The Admirable Campaign (Spanish: Campaña Admirable) was a military action led by Simón Bolívar in which the provinces of Mérida, Barinas, Trujillo and Caracas were conquered by the Patriots. Its objective was to free Venezuela from Spanish control, which was accomplished in conjunction with Santiago Mariño's simultaneous campaign in the east.

Intended as a punitive expedition against Buleleng's raids in Eastern Java, the expedition obtained the submission of Buleleng's king I Gusti Gde Karang without violence.

en.s: The Battle of Stillman's Run, also known as the Battle of Sycamore Creek or the Battle of Old Man's Creek, occurred in Illinois on May 14, 1832. The battle was named for the panicked retreat by Major Isaiah Stillman and his detachment of 275 Illinois militia after being attacked by many fewer Sauk warriors of Black Hawk's British Band. The engagement was the first battle of the Black Hawk War (1832), which developed after Black Hawk crossed the Mississippi River from Iowa into Illinois with his band of Sauk and Fox warriors to try to reclaim territory.

zh.s: 斯蒂尔曼河奔逃战又称西卡莫尔溪战役或老曼溪战役，于1832年5月14日在伊利诺伊州发生。战役名称源自伊赛亚·斯蒂尔曼少校及其275名伊利诺伊州民兵部下遭黑鹰领导的英国部落少数萨克族战士袭击后惊慌撤退。此役是1832年黑鹰战争的第一场战斗。黑鹰率萨克族和福克斯族战士从爱荷华州渡过密西西比河进入伊利诺伊州，试图收回原属部族的土地，随后引发了这场战争。

en.s: The Black Hawk War was a brief 1832 conflict, between the United States and Native Americans, led by Black Hawk, a Sauk leader. The war erupted soon after Black Hawk and a group of Sauks, Meskwakis, and Kickapoos, known as the "British Band", crossed the Mississippi River, into the US state of Illinois, from Iowa Indian Territory in April 1832. Black Hawk's motives were ambiguous, but he was apparently hoping to avoid bloodshed while resettling on tribal land that had been ceded to the United States in the disputed 1804 Treaty of St. Louis.

zh.s: 黑鹰战争是1832年美国与美洲原住民之间的一场短暂冲突，原住民由索克族领袖黑鹰率领。1832年4月，黑鹰与一群索克族、梅斯克瓦基族和基卡普族人（合称“英方同盟”）从艾奥瓦印第安领地渡过密西西比河，进入美国伊利诺伊州后不久，战争爆发。黑鹰的动机并不明确，但他显然希望避免流血，同时带领族人迁回部族土地；这片土地已根据1804年有争议的《圣路易斯条约》割让给美国。

en.t: The first edition of The Illustrated London News, the world's first illustrated weekly news magazine, is published
en.s: The Illustrated London News, founded by Herbert Ingram and first published on Saturday 14 May 1842, was the world's first illustrated weekly news magazine. The magazine was published weekly for most of its existence, switched to a less frequent publication schedule in 1971, and eventually ceased publication in 2003. The company continues today as Illustrated London News Ltd, a publishing, content, and digital agency in London, which holds the publication and business archives of the magazine.

zh.s: 《伦敦新闻画报》由赫伯特·英格拉姆创办，1842年5月14日星期六首次发行，是世界上第一本插图周刊。该杂志在大部分时期每周发行，1971年起改为较低频率出版，最终于2003年停刊。公司现以Illustrated London News Ltd之名继续运营，成为一家位于伦敦的出版、内容和数字服务机构，并保存该杂志的出版及业务档案。

en.s: The May Coup d'État (Polish: Przewrót majowy or zamach majowy) was a coup d'état carried out in Poland by Marshal Józef Piłsudski between 12 and 14 May 1926. The coup overthrew the government of President Stanisław Wojciechowski and Prime Minister Wincenty Witos. A new government was installed, headed by Lwów Polytechnic Professor Kazimierz Bartel. The events were partly inspired by the need for extraordinary measures in the face of newly emerging threats to stability of Poland's independence by Piłsudski's own assessment of the foreign treaties signed by Weimar Germany with France in 1925 (fundamentally abandoning Poland) and with the Soviet Russia in April 1926, to which Poland's representatives had not been invited.

en.s: The Battle of Hannut (not to be confused with the Battle of Gembloux Gap) was a Second World War battle fought during the Battle of Belgium which took place between 12 and 14 May 1940 at Hannut, Belgium. It was the largest ever tank battle at the time. The primary purpose of the Germans was to tie down the strongest elements of the 1st French Army and remove it from the German's Army Group A main thrust through the Ardennes, as laid out in the German operational plan Fall Gelb, or "Case Yellow", by General Erich von Manstein.

zh.s: 汉努特战役是第二次世界大战比利时战役期间的一场战斗，于1940年5月12日至14日在比利时汉努特发生。它是当时规模最大的坦克战。德军的主要目标是牵制法国第一集团军最精锐的部队，使其无法参与德国A集团军经阿登地区推进的主攻。该计划由埃里希·冯·曼施坦因将军制定，名为“黄色方案”。

en.s: The Battle of Rotterdam was a Second World War battle fought during the Battle of the Netherlands. Fought between 10 and 14 May 1940, it was a German attempt to seize the Dutch city. It ended in a German victory, following the Rotterdam Blitz.

zh.s: 鹿特丹战役是第二次世界大战荷兰战役期间的一场战斗，于1940年5月10日至14日进行。德军试图夺取荷兰城市鹿特丹，最终在鹿特丹大轰炸后获胜。

en.s: In 1940, Rotterdam was subjected to heavy aerial bombardment by the Luftwaffe during the German invasion of the Netherlands during the Second World War. The objective was to support the German troops fighting in the city, break Dutch resistance and force the Dutch army to surrender. Bombing began at the outset of hostilities on 10 May and culminated with the destruction of the entire historic city centre on 14 May, an event sometimes referred to as the Rotterdam Blitz.

zh.s: 1940年，第二次世界大战期间，德国入侵荷兰，德国空军对鹿特丹实施猛烈空袭，以支援在城内作战的德军、瓦解荷兰抵抗并迫使荷兰军队投降。轰炸于5月10日敌对行动开始时展开，5月14日达到高潮，整座历史市中心被毁。这一事件有时被称为“鹿特丹闪电战”。

en.s: Operation Fritham (30 April – 14 May 1942) was an Allied military operation during the Second World War to secure the coal mines on Spitsbergen, the main island of the Svalbard Archipelago, 650 mi (1,050 km) from the North Pole and about the same distance from Norway. The operation was intended to deny the islands to Nazi Germany.

en.s: The Battle of Murowana Oszmianka of 13–14 May 1944 was the largest clash between the Polish resistance movement organization Home Army (Armia Krajowa, AK) and the Lithuanian Territorial Defense Force (LTDF); a Lithuanian volunteer security force subordinated to Nazi Germany occupational administration. The battle took place in and near the village of Murowana Oszmianka in Generalbezirk Litauen, part of the Reichskommissariat Ostland.

zh.t: 穆罗瓦纳奥什米扬卡战役
zh.s: 穆罗瓦纳奥什米扬卡战役于1944年5月13日至14日爆发，是波兰抵抗组织本土军与立陶宛地方防卫队之间规模最大的一次交战。立陶宛地方防卫队是一支受纳粹德国占领当局控制的志愿治安部队。战斗发生在奥斯特兰德国家专员辖区“立陶宛总区”内的穆罗瓦纳奥什米扬卡村及附近地区。

en.s: The Israeli Declaration of Independence, formally the Declaration of the Establishment of the State of Israel (Hebrew: הכרזה על הקמת מדינת ישראל), was proclaimed at the Tel Aviv Museum on 14 May 1948 (5 Iyar 5708), at the end of the civil war phase and beginning of the Arab–Israeli War of the 1948 Palestine war, by the Va'ad Leumi led by David Ben-Gurion, the executive head of the World Zionist Organization and chairman of the Jewish Agency for Palestine.

zh.s: 以色列《独立宣言》正式名称为《以色列国建国宣言》（希伯来语：הכרזה על הקמת מדינת ישראל），于1948年5月14日（5708年伊亚尔月5日）在特拉维夫博物馆宣读。当时，巴勒斯坦战争的内战阶段刚结束，阿以战争随即开始。宣言由全国委员会颁布，该委员会由世界犹太复国主义组织执行主席、巴勒斯坦犹太机构主席戴维·本-古里安领导。

en.s: The 1950 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade Olympique Yves-du-Manoir, Colombes on 14 May 1950, that saw Stade de Reims defeat RC Paris 2–0 thanks to goals by Francis Méano and André Petitfils.

zh.s: 1950年法国杯决赛于1950年5月14日在科隆布的伊夫·迪马努瓦尔奥林匹克体育场举行。兰斯体育俱乐部凭借弗朗西斯·梅阿诺和安德烈·珀蒂菲尔斯的进球，以2比0击败巴黎竞技队。

en.s: The Kulmbach by-election on May 14, 1950 was the first by-election for the Bundestag (Germany) that had been established 1949. It was caused by the death of Friedrich Schönauer (SPD) April 4, 1950 who had been elected at the 1949 German federal election Despite an increased result of the SPD, they lost the seat to Johannes Semler (CSU), who was supported by BP and FDP.

zh.s: 1950年5月14日举行的库尔姆巴赫补选是德国1949年成立的联邦议院首次补选。补选因社会民主党议员弗里德里希·舍瑙尔于1950年4月4日去世而举行，他是在1949年德国联邦选举中当选的。社会民主党得票有所增加，但仍输掉该席位；基督教社会联盟候选人约翰内斯·泽姆勒在巴伐利亚党和自由民主党的支持下当选。

en.s: General elections were held in Turkey on 14 May 1950, using the multiple non-transferable vote electoral system. The result was a landslide victory for the opposition Democrat Party (DP), which won 416 of the 487 seats with 55% of the vote. Unlike the previous elections in 1946, the 1950 elections took place in a calm atmosphere.

zh.s: 土耳其于1950年5月14日举行大选，采用不可转让多票制。反对党民主党大获全胜，以55%的得票率赢得487席中的416席。与1946年的上一次选举不同，1950年选举在平静的氛围中举行。

en.t: Trains run on the Talyllyn Railway in Wales for the first time since preservation, making it the first railway in the world to be operated by volunteers
en.s: The Talyllyn Railway (Welsh: Rheilffordd Talyllyn) is a narrow-gauge railway in Wales, which runs for 7+1⁄4 miles (12 km) from Tywyn on the Mid-Wales coast to Nant Gwernol near the village of Abergynolwyn. Opened in 1865 to carry slate from the quarries at Bryn Eglwys to Tywyn, it was the first narrow-gauge railway in Britain authorised by Act of Parliament to carry passengers using steam haulage.

zh.t: 塔利林铁路保护后首次恢复运营，成为世界上首条由志愿者运营的铁路
zh.s: 塔利林铁路（威尔士语：Rheilffordd Talyllyn）是威尔士的一条窄轨铁路，全长7又1/4英里（12公里），从威尔士中部海岸的蒂温通往阿伯格温诺尔温村附近的南特格温诺尔。铁路于1865年开通，用于将布林埃格尔维斯采石场的板岩运到蒂温。它是英国首条经议会法案批准、使用蒸汽机车载客的窄轨铁路。

en.s: The 1953 Milwaukee brewery strike was a strike action involving approximately 7,100 workers at six breweries in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, United States. The strike began on May 14 of that year after the Brewery Workers Union Local 9 and an employers' organization representing six Milwaukee-based brewing companies failed to agree to new labor contracts.

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Turkey on 14 May 1954. 513 out of 541 members of the Grand National Assembly participated in the elections, which were held as required by law immediately after the election of the members of the tenth parliament. Incumbent president Celâl Bayar was re-elected to the presidency with 486 votes in the first round. In the same year the 1954 Turkish general election were held.

zh.s: 土耳其于1954年5月14日举行间接总统选举。541名大国民议会议员中有513人参加投票。按法律规定，选举在第十届议会议员选出后立即举行。现任总统杰拉勒·巴亚尔在首轮投票中获得486票，连任总统。同年土耳其还举行了大选。

en.s: The 1959 Manitoba general election was held on May 14, 1959 to elect 57 members to the Legislative Assembly of Manitoba, Canada. It resulted in a majority victory for the incumbent Progressive Conservatives under the leadership of Premier Dufferin Roblin. It was the first time since the 1914 election that the PCs won an outright majority in the province, when they were led by Dufferin Roblin's grandfather, Sir Rodmond Roblin.

zh.s: 1959年曼尼托巴省选举于5月14日举行，选出加拿大曼尼托巴省议会57名议员。由省长达弗林·罗布林领导的执政进步保守党取得多数席位。这是自1914年以来该党首次在该省获得绝对多数；1914年该党的领导人是达弗林的祖父罗德蒙德·罗布林爵士。

en.s: Elections to Hale Council were held on Saturday, 14 May 1966. One third of the councillors were up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a three-year term of office. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council.

zh.s: 黑尔市议会选举于1966年5月14日（星期六）举行，三分之一议员席位改选。每名当选者任期3年。保守党保住了市议会的整体控制权。

en.s: The 1966 FA Cup final was a football match played on 14 May 1966. It was contested by Everton and Sheffield Wednesday at Wembley. Everton were the first team since Bury in 1903 to reach an FA Cup Final without conceding a goal, while Sheffield Wednesday reached the final having played every round away. Everton came back from 2–0 down to win 3–2 with goals by Mike Trebilcock (2) and Derek Temple.

zh.s: 1966年英格兰足总杯决赛于1966年5月14日举行，由埃弗顿和谢菲尔德星期三在温布利球场争夺冠军。自1903年的伯里队以来，埃弗顿是首支以零失球战绩闯入决赛的球队；谢菲尔德星期三则每一轮都是客场作战。埃弗顿一度以0比2落后，随后凭借迈克·特雷比尔科克（两球）和德里克·坦普尔的进球，以3比2逆转获胜。

en.t: Founding of the Tzu Chi Merit Association
en.s: Buddhist nun Cheng Yen founded the Tzu Chi Merit Association in Hualien, Taiwan. The association brought together a small group of followers to provide organized help for people living in poverty.
en.n: The date follows Tzu Chi’s official founder biography and chronology: May 14, 1966, the 24th day of the intercalary third lunar month. Some English accounts give April 14.

zh.s: 佛教比丘尼证严法师在台湾花莲创立慈济功德会。该会由一小群追随者组成，致力于有组织地帮助贫困人群。
zh.n: 日期依据慈济官方创办人传记和年表：1966年5月14日，即闰三月二十四日。部分英文资料记为4月14日。

en.s: Operation Junction City was an 82-day military operation conducted by United States (US) and South Vietnam forces against Viet Cong (VC) forces begun on 22 February 1967 during the Vietnam War. It was the first US combat airborne operation since the Korean War and one of the largest airmobile operations of the war.

zh.s: 交界城行动是美国和南越军队在越南战争期间针对越共开展的一次军事行动，历时82天，于1967年2月22日开始。这是朝鲜战争后美国首次投入作战的空降行动，也是越战中规模最大的机动空中作战之一。

en.s: The elections were held on 14 May 1971, with one third up for vote. Since the previous election, a by-election in November for Burngreave seen the Liberals increase their representation to two, with a gain from Labour. Immediately following last year's election, the allocation of fourteen retiring Alderman was decided, with Labour taking the overwhelming majority, strengthened by their election performance and the knowledge that if repeated it would lead to a landslide victory for them. Labour leader Ironmongers' prediction of an aforementioned landslide played out in this election, with Labour making over a dozen gains, with all-but-one coming from their competitor the Conservatives - the other being a Liberal seat in Heeley won in a by-election in 1969.

zh.s: 谢菲尔德市议会选举于1971年5月14日举行，三分之一议席改选。上次选举后，伯恩格里夫选区于11月举行补选，自由党击败工党，使自由党议员增至两名。上一年选举结束后，议会确定了14名即将卸任的市政参事席位分配，工党获得绝大多数。工党在本次选举中势头更强，工党领袖艾恩蒙格斯此前预言的大胜最终实现：工党新增十多个席位，其中除希利选区一席外，其余均从保守党手中赢得；希利席位是自由党在1969年补选中获胜的。

en.t: 1972 All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship final
en.s: The 1972 All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship final was a hurling match played at Walsh Park on 14 May 1972 to determine the winners of the 1971–72 All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship, the second season of the All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship, a tournament organised by the Gaelic Athletic Association for the champion clubs of the four provinces of Ireland.

zh.t: 1972年全爱尔兰高级俱乐部曲棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1972年全爱尔兰高级俱乐部曲棍球锦标赛决赛于1972年5月14日在沃尔什公园举行，决出1971—72赛季冠军。这是全爱尔兰高级俱乐部曲棍球锦标赛的第二个赛季。该赛事由盖尔体育协会主办，参赛俱乐部是爱尔兰四个省的冠军队。

en.s: The Battle at Springmartin was a series of gun battles in Belfast, Northern Ireland on 13–14 May 1972, as part of The Troubles. It involved the British Army, the Provisional Irish Republican Army, the Official Irish Republican Army, and the Ulster Volunteer Force (UVF). The violence began when a car bomb, planted by Ulster loyalists, exploded outside a crowded pub in the mainly Irish nationalist and Catholic district of Ballymurphy.

en.s: The 1975 European Cup Winners' Cup final was a football match held at St. Jakob Stadium in Basel, Switzerland on 14 May 1975. It was the final match of the 1974–75 European Cup Winners' Cup – the 15th European Cup Winners' Cup final – and was contested by Dynamo Kyiv of the Soviet Union and Ferencváros of Hungary.

zh.s: 1975年欧洲优胜者杯决赛于1975年5月14日在瑞士巴塞尔的圣雅各布球场举行，是1974—75赛季该项赛事的最后一场比赛，也是第15届决赛。对阵双方是苏联基辅迪纳摩和匈牙利费伦茨瓦罗斯。

en.s: 1976 JSL Cup final was the first final of the JSL Cup competition. The final was played at National Stadium in Tokyo on May 14, 1976. Hitachi won the championship.

zh.s: 1976年日本足球联赛杯决赛是该项赛事的首届决赛，于1976年5月14日在东京国立竞技场举行。日立队夺得冠军。

en.s: The 1977 Dan-Air/IAS Cargo Boeing 707 crash was a fatal accident involving a Boeing 707-321C cargo aircraft operated by Dan Air Services Limited on behalf of International Aviation Services Limited (trading as IAS Cargo Airlines at the time of the accident), which had been sub-contracted by Zambia Airways Corporation to operate a weekly scheduled all-cargo service between London Heathrow and the Zambian capital Lusaka via Athens and Nairobi. The aircraft crashed during approach to Lusaka Airport, Zambia, on 14 May 1977. All six occupants of the aircraft were killed.

zh.s: 1977年丹航空/IAS货运波音707空难是一起致命事故，涉事波音707-321C货机由丹航空服务有限公司运营，代表国际航空服务有限公司执行任务；后者当时以IAS货运航空名义经营，并受赞比亚航空公司委托，运营伦敦希思罗机场经雅典和内罗毕飞往赞比亚首都卢萨卡的每周定期货运航线。飞机于1977年5月14日在赞比亚卢萨卡机场进场时坠毁，机上6人全部遇难。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Republic of Upper Volta on 14 May 1978, with a second round on 28 May after no candidate won more than 50% in the first round. They were the country's first multi-party presidential elections, the previous elections in 1965 having Maurice Yaméogo as the sole candidate. They were also the first presidential elections held under a revised Constitution adopted a year earlier.

zh.s: 上沃尔特共和国于1978年5月14日举行总统选举。由于没有候选人首轮得票超过50%，第二轮投票于5月28日举行。这是该国首次多党总统选举；此前的1965年总统选举中，莫里斯·亚梅奥戈是唯一候选人。这也是该国在一年前通过修订宪法后举行的首次总统选举。

en.s: The 1980 European Cup Winners' Cup final was a football match contested on 14 May 1980 between Arsenal of England and Valencia of Spain. The final was held at Heysel Stadium in Brussels, Belgium. Valencia won the match 5–4 on penalties. It was the 20th European Cup Winners' Cup final and the only time that the title was decided by a penalty shoot-out.

zh.s: 1980年欧洲优胜者杯决赛于1980年5月14日举行，由英格兰阿森纳对阵西班牙瓦伦西亚，比赛地点是比利时布鲁塞尔的海瑟尔球场。瓦伦西亚在点球大战中以5比4获胜。这是欧洲优胜者杯第20届决赛，也是该项赛事唯一一次通过点球大战决出冠军。

en.s: The 35th Cannes Film Festival took place from 14 to 26 May 1982. Italian opera and theatre director Giorgio Strehler served as jury president for the main competition. en.s: The Fiji coups of 1987 resulted in the overthrow of the elected government of Fijian Prime Minister Timoci Bavadra, the deposition of Elizabeth II as Queen of Fiji, and in the declaration of a republic. The first coup, in which Bavadra was deposed, took place on 14 May 1987; a second coup on 28 September ended the Fijian Monarchy, and was shortly followed by the proclamation of a republic on 7 October.

zh.s: 1987年斐济政变推翻了总理蒂莫西·巴瓦德拉领导的民选政府，废黜了斐济女王伊丽莎白二世，并最终建立共和国。第一次政变于1987年5月14日发生，巴瓦德拉在政变中下台。第二次政变于9月28日发生，终结斐济君主制；随后斐济于10月7日宣布成立共和国。

en.t: Fijian Prime Minister Timoci Bavadra is ousted from power in a coup d'état led by Lieutenant colonel Sitiveni Rabuka
en.s: Timoci Uluivuda Bavadra (22 September 1934 – 3 November 1989) was a Fijian medical doctor who founded the Fiji Labour Party and served as the Prime Minister of Fiji for one month in 1987. He was born in Viseisei, Viti Levu, and was a medical doctor and politician by profession. Contesting his first election in 1987, Bavadra forged an electoral coalition between his Labour Party and the much older, Indo-Fijian-dominated National Federation Party.

zh.t: 斐济总理蒂莫西·巴瓦德拉在西蒂韦尼·兰布卡中校领导的政变中被赶下台
zh.s: 蒂莫西·乌卢维达·巴瓦德拉（1934 年 9 月 22 日—1989 年 11 月 3 日）是斐济医生，也是斐济工党创始人。他于 1987 年担任斐济总理，任期仅一个月。巴瓦德拉首次参加 1987 年大选时，将其工党与历史更悠久、以印裔斐济人为主的民族联盟党组成选举联盟。

en.s: The 1988 FA Cup final was the 107th final of the FA Cup. It took place on Saturday 14 May 1988 at Wembley Stadium and was contested between Wimbledon and Liverpool, the dominant English club side of the 1980s and newly crowned league champions.

zh.s: 1988年英格兰足总杯决赛是该赛事第107届决赛，于1988年5月14日星期六在温布利球场举行，由温布尔登对阵利物浦。利物浦是1980年代英格兰足坛的强队，并在此前刚赢得联赛冠军。

en.s: The 1988 Scottish Cup Final was played between Celtic and Dundee United at Hampden Park on 14 May 1988. Celtic had reached the final after coming from behind to defeat Hearts 2-1 in the semi-final, while Dundee United had defeated Aberdeen 1-0 in their semi-final after two replays. Celtic won 2–1, with Frank McAvennie scoring both of their goals.

zh.s: 1988年苏格兰杯决赛于1988年5月14日在汉普顿公园举行，由凯尔特人对阵邓迪联。凯尔特人在半决赛中先落后、后以2比1击败哈茨；邓迪联则在两次重赛后以1比0淘汰阿伯丁。凯尔特人最终以2比1获胜，弗兰克·麦卡文尼攻入两球。

en.t: Carrollton bus collision: A drunk driver traveling the wrong way on Interstate 71 near Carrollton, Kentucky, hits a converted school bus carrying a church youth group. Twenty-seven die in the crash and ensuing fire
en.s: The Carrollton bus collision occurred on May 14, 1988, on Interstate 71 in unincorporated Carroll County, Kentucky, United States. The collision involved a former school bus in use by a church youth group and a pickup truck driven by an alcohol-impaired driver. The head-on collision was the deadliest incident involving drunk driving and the third-deadliest bus crash in U.S. history.

zh.t: 卡罗尔顿校车相撞事故：醉酒司机在肯塔基州卡罗尔顿附近逆向驶入71号州际公路，撞上一辆载有教会青年团的校车，事故及火灾共造成27人死亡
zh.s: 卡罗尔顿校车相撞事故于1988年5月14日发生在美国肯塔基州卡罗尔县一段未设建制的71号州际公路上。事故车辆是一辆改作教会青年团交通工具的旧校车，以及一辆由酒后驾驶者驾驶的皮卡。迎头相撞事故是美国史上最严重的酒后驾驶事故，也是第三严重的巴士事故。

en.s: The 1994 FA Cup final was an association football match that took place on 14 May 1994 at Wembley Stadium in London to determine the winner of the 1993–94 FA Cup. It was contested between Chelsea and Manchester United. Four goals in the second half from Eric Cantona (who scored twice), Mark Hughes and Brian McClair gave Manchester United their eighth FA Cup title.

zh.s: 1994年英格兰足总杯决赛于1994年5月14日在伦敦温布利球场举行，决出1993—94赛季冠军。对阵双方为切尔西和曼彻斯特联。曼联在下半场连进4球，其中埃里克·坎通纳梅开二度，马克·休斯和布莱恩·麦克莱尔各进一球，帮助球队赢得队史第8座足总杯。

en.s: The 1994 Coupe de France final was a football match held at the Stade de France, Saint-Denis, Seine-Saint-Denis, France on 14 May 1994. The match was played between AJ Auxerre and Montpellier HSC in what was the conclusion to the 1993–94 Coupe de France. Auxerre won the match 3–0 thanks to goals by Moussa Saïb, Gérald Baticle and Corentin Martins.

zh.s: 1994年法国杯决赛于1994年5月14日在法国塞纳-圣但尼省圣但尼的法兰西体育场举行。对阵双方为欧塞尔和蒙彼利埃。欧塞尔凭穆萨·赛义布、热拉尔·巴蒂克尔和科兰坦·马丁斯的进球，以3比0获胜。

en.s: The 1994 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1993–94 DFB-Pokal, the 51st season of Germany's premier knockout football cup competition. It was played on 14 May 1994 at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. Werder Bremen won the match 3–1 against Rot-Weiss Essen to claim their third cup title, qualifying for the 1994–95 UEFA Cup Winners' Cup and the 1994 DFB-Supercup.

zh.s: 1994年德国杯决赛决出了1993—94赛季德国杯冠军，这是德国顶级淘汰制足球杯赛的第51个赛季。决赛于1994年5月14日在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。云达不来梅以3比1击败红白埃森，第三次夺得德国杯冠军，并获得1994—95赛季欧洲优胜者杯和1994年德国超级杯的参赛资格。

en.s: The 1994 Coburg state by-election was held on 14 May 1994 to elect the next member for Coburg in the Victorian Legislative Assembly, following the resignation of sitting MP Tom Roper on 31 March 1994. The seat was retained for the Labor Party by candidate Carlo Carli, who held the seat until it was abolished in 2002.

zh.s: 1994年科堡州议会补选于1994年5月14日举行，为维多利亚州议会下院选出新的科堡选区议员。补选由现任议员汤姆·罗珀于1994年3月31日辞职引发。工党候选人卡洛·卡利保住了该席位，并一直担任议员，直到该选区于2002年撤销。

en.s: When Worlds Collide was the name of two professional wrestling live events produced by the professional wrestling promotion Eastern Championship Wrestling/Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW) in 1994 and 1996 respectively. Both events were held in the ECW Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania in the United States.

zh.s: 《世界碰撞》是美国东部冠军摔角／极限冠军摔角推广联盟于1994年和1996年分别举办的两场职业摔角现场赛事。两场赛事均在美国宾夕法尼亚州费城的ECW竞技场举行。

en.s: The North Rhine-Westphalia state election, 1995 was held on May 14, 1995 to elect 221 members of the Landtag (state legislature) of the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia. The incumbent state government at that time was a SPD majority government led by Johannes Rau that tried to defend its majority after 15 years in power. The main opposition was the CDU led by Helmut Linssen since 1990. The election took place several months after Helmut Kohl was sworn in as Chancellor of Germany for the fifth time after his CDU/CSU/FDPcoalition government defended its majority in the 1994 federal election.

zh.t: 1995年北莱茵-威斯特法伦州选举
zh.s: 德国北莱茵-威斯特法伦州于1995年5月14日举行州选举，选出该州议会的221名议员。时任州政府由社民党（SPD）单独执政，约翰内斯·劳领导的政府已执政15年，希望继续保住多数席位。主要反对党为自1990年以来由赫尔穆特·林森领导的基民盟（CDU）。此次选举在赫尔穆特·科尔第五次宣誓就任德国总理数月后举行；科尔领导的基民盟/基社盟与自民党联盟在1994年联邦大选中成功保住多数席位。

en.s: In Your House (retroactively titled In Your House: Premiere, and sequentially known as In Your House 1) was a 1995 professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the inaugural In Your House and took place on May 14, 1995, at the Onondaga County War Memorial in Syracuse, New York.

zh.s: 《在你家里》（后来追称《在你家里：首演》，按顺序也称《在你家里1》）是世界摔角联合会（WWF，现WWE）制作的首场《在你家里》职业摔角付费点播赛事。赛事于1995年5月14日在纽约州锡拉丘兹的奥农达加县战争纪念馆举行。

en.s: The 1995 Bremen state election was held on 14 May 1995 to elect the members of the Bürgerschaft of Bremen, as well as the city councils of Bremen and Bremerhaven. The incumbent coalition was a traffic light coalition of the Social Democratic Party (SPD), The Greens, and the Free Democratic Party (FDP) led by Mayor Klaus Wedemeier. The coalition was defeated as the FDP lost its representation in the Bürgerschaft.

zh.s: 1995年不来梅州选举于1995年5月14日举行，选出不来梅州议会（Bürgerschaft）议员，并改选不来梅和不来梅哈芬两个市议会。时任州政府是由社会民主党、绿党和自由民主党组成的“红绿灯联盟”，由市长克劳斯·韦德迈尔领导。自由民主党失去州议会席位，执政联盟因此落败。

en.s: The 1997 UEFA Cup Winners' Cup Final was a football match contested between Barcelona of Spain and the cup holders Paris Saint-Germain of France, to determine the winner of the 1996–97 UEFA Cup Winners' Cup and the 37th overall Cup Winners' Cup final. It was held at De Kuip in Rotterdam on 14 May 1997. Barcelona won the match 1–0 thanks to a Ronaldo penalty.

zh.s: 1997年欧洲优胜者杯决赛由西班牙巴塞罗那对阵卫冕冠军、法国巴黎圣日耳曼，决出1996—97赛季冠军，也是该项赛事第37届决赛。比赛于1997年5月14日在鹿特丹的德奎普球场举行。巴塞罗那凭借罗纳尔多罚进的一粒点球，以1比0获胜。

en.s: It Ain't Seinfeld was a professional wrestling live event produced by the American professional wrestling promotion Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW). It took place on May 14, 1998 in the Elks Lodge #878 in Elmhurst, Queens, New York City, New York in the United States. Eight matches took place at the event. The main event was a six-man tag team match pitting The Dudley Brothers (Buh Buh Ray Dudley, D-Von Dudley and Big Dick Dudley) against Tommy Dreamer, Spike Dudley and The Sandman. The event also saw the introduction of the ECW FTW Heavyweight Championship by Taz.

zh.t: 《这可不是宋飞正传》职业摔角赛
zh.s: 《这可不是宋飞正传》是美国职业摔角推广组织极限冠军摔角（ECW）举办的一场现场赛事，于1998年5月14日在纽约市皇后区埃姆赫斯特的878号麋鹿会会所举行。赛事共有8场比赛。主赛是一场六人组队赛，杜德利兄弟（布布·雷·杜德利、迪沃恩·杜德利和大迪克·杜德利）对阵汤米·德里默、斯派克·杜德利和桑德曼。赛事期间，塔兹还创立了ECW FTW重量级冠军头衔。

en.s: The 1998 North Sumatra gubernatorial election was an indirect election held to elect the Governor of North Sumatra for the 1998–2003 term. All members of the Regional People's Representative Council of North Sumatra were eligible to vote for this election.

zh.s: 1998年北苏门答腊省长选举采用间接选举方式，选出任期为1998年至2003年的省长。北苏门答腊省地区人民代表委员会的所有成员均有权参加投票。

en.s: The Anadrinë offensive also known as the Battle of Anadrinë or the Battle of Gradish was fought between the Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA) and the Yugoslav Army (VJ) and Ministry of Internal Affairs (MUP) during the early stages of the Kosovo War. The fighting occurred during 12-14 May 1998, over 2 months since the start of all-out fighting in Kosovo.

en.s: Hardcore Heaven (2000) was the sixth and final Hardcore Heaven professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW). The event took place on May 14, 2000, at The Rave in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The commentators for the event were Joey Styles, Joel Gertner and Cyrus. Nine professional wrestling matches were contested at the event. In the main event, Justin Credible successfully defended the World Heavyweight Championship against Lance Storm.

zh.s: 《硬核天堂》（2000年）是极限冠军摔角（ECW）制作的第六场、也是最后一场同名职业摔角付费直播赛事。赛事于2000年5月14日在威斯康星州密尔沃基的The Rave举行，共有9场职业摔角比赛。解说员为乔伊·斯泰尔斯、乔尔·格特纳和赛勒斯。主赛中，贾斯汀·克雷迪布尔成功卫冕世界重量级冠军，击败兰斯·斯托姆。

en.s: The 2000 Belgian Cup final, took place on 14 May 2000 between Genk and Standard Liège. It was the 45th Belgian Cup final and was won by Genk, coming back from an early goal by Frédéric Pierre to win 4-1.

zh.s: 2000年比利时杯决赛于2000年5月14日举行，由亨克对阵标准列日。这是比利时杯第45届决赛。亨克在弗雷德里克·皮埃尔率先破门后连进四球，以4比1逆转夺冠。

en.s: The 53rd Cannes Film Festival took place from 14 to 25 May 2000. French filmmaker Luc Besson was the Jury President for the main competition. Virginie Ledoyen was the mistress of ceremonies. Danish filmmaker Lars von Trier won the Palme d'Or for the musical-drama film Dancer in the Dark. The festival opened with Vatel by Roland Joffé, and closed with Stardom by Denys Arcand.

zh.s: 第53届戛纳电影节于2000年5月14日至25日举行。法国电影人吕克·贝松担任主竞赛单元评审团主席，维尔日妮·勒多延担任司仪。丹麦导演拉斯·冯·提尔凭音乐剧情片《黑暗中的舞者》获得金棕榈奖。电影节以罗兰·约菲执导的《瓦泰尔》开幕，以丹尼斯·阿尔康执导的《明星》闭幕。

en.s: Legislative elections and local elections were held in the Philippines on May 14, 2001 Independent candidate Noli de Castro, a former television anchor of TV Patrol of ABS-CBN was announced as the topnotcher. This is the first synchronized national and local elections held after the ouster of Former President Joseph Estrada in January due to a military-backed civilian uprising (popularly known as EDSA II). On February 20, 2007, the Supreme Court of the Philippines ruled that Former Senator Gregorio Honasan lost in the 2001 Philippine elections and lost to Sen. Ralph Recto but declared constitutional the special election for the remaining three-year term of Teofisto Guingona.

zh.s: 菲律宾于2001年5月14日举行立法和地方选举。独立候选人、ABS-CBN电视台《TV Patrol》前主播诺利·德卡斯特罗被宣布为参议员选举中的得票最高者。这是约瑟夫·埃斯特拉达总统于同年1月在军方支持的民众起义（俗称“二次人民力量革命”）中下台后，首次同步举行全国和地方选举。2007年2月20日，菲律宾最高法院裁定，前参议员格雷戈里奥·霍纳桑在2001年选举中落败，拉尔夫·雷克托赢得席位；法院同时裁定，为填补特奥菲斯托·金戈纳剩余三年任期举行的特别选举符合宪法。

en.s: The senatorial election was held in the Philippines on May 14, 2001 Independent candidate Noli de Castro, a former television anchor of TV Patrol of ABS-CBN was announced as the topnotcher. This is the first synchronized national and local elections held after the ouster of Former President Joseph Estrada in January due to a military-backed civilian uprising (popularly known as EDSA II). The two competing coalitions in this election were the People Power Coalition (PPC) which supported Estrada's ouster, and the Puwersa ng Masa (Force of the Masses) coalition that supported Estrada.

zh.s: 菲律宾于2001年5月14日举行参议员选举。独立候选人诺利·德卡斯特罗是ABS-CBN电视台《TV Patrol》的前主播，被宣布为得票最高者。这是埃斯特拉达总统于同年1月在军方支持的民众起义（俗称“二次人民力量革命”）中下台后，首次同步举行全国和地方选举。此次选举有两个竞争联盟：支持埃斯特拉达下台的人民力量联盟（PPC），以及支持埃斯特拉达的群众力量联盟（Puwersa ng Masa）。

en.s: The Elections for the House of Representatives of the Philippines were held on May 14, 2001. This was the next election succeeding the events of the 2001 EDSA Revolution that deposed Joseph Estrada from the presidency; his vice president, Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo became president, and her party, Lakas NUCD-UMDP, and by extension the People Power Coalition (PPC), dominated the midterm elections winning majority of the seats in the Senate and in the House of Representatives. The elected representatives will serve in the 12th Congress from 2001 to 2004.

zh.s: 菲律宾众议院选举于2001年5月14日举行。这是约瑟夫·埃斯特拉达总统在2001年二次人民力量革命中下台后的首次选举；其副总统格洛丽亚·马卡帕加尔-阿罗约接任总统。阿罗约所属的拉卡斯党及其领导的人民力量联盟在中期选举中占据参议院和众议院多数席位。当选议员任职于2001年至2004年的第12届国会。大多数议员由约25万选民组成的地理选区直接选出。众议院的选区席位共220个。

en.s: Local elections were held in Cebu City on May 14, 2001, within the Philippine general election. Registered voters of the city elected candidates for the following elective local posts: mayor, vice mayor, district representatives, and eight councilors for each district. There are two legislative districts in the city.

zh.s: 2001年5月14日，宿务市举行地方选举，这是菲律宾大选的一部分。该市登记选民选出市长、副市长、各区众议员，以及每个选区的八名市议员。宿务市有两个众议院选区。

en.s: Local elections were held in Pasay on May 14, 2001, within the Philippine general election. The voters elected for the elective local posts in the city: the mayor, vice mayor, the representative for the lone district, and the councilors, six of them in the two districts of the city.

zh.s: 2001年5月14日，帕赛举行地方选举，这是菲律宾大选的一部分。选民选出市长、副市长、该市单一选区的众议员，以及市内两个选区共六名市议员。

en.s: Local elections were held in Quezon City on May 14, 2001, within the Philippine general election. The voters elected for the elective local posts in the city: the mayor, vice mayor, the four Congressmen, and the councilors, 6 in each of the city's four legislative districts.

zh.s: 2001年5月14日，奎松市举行地方选举，这是菲律宾大选的一部分。选民选出市长、副市长、四名众议员，以及该市四个众议院选区各六名市议员。

en.s: Local elections was held in the City of Makati on May 14, 2001, within the Philippine general election. The voters elected for the elective local posts in the city: the mayor, vice mayor, the two congressmen, and the councilors, eight in each of the city's two legislative districts.

zh.s: 2001年5月14日，马卡蒂市举行地方选举，这是菲律宾大选的一部分。选民选出市长、副市长、两名众议员，以及市内两个众议院选区各八名市议员。

en.s: Local elections were held in Naga City, Camarines Sur, on May 14, 2001, as part of the 2001 Philippine general election. Voters elected a mayor, vice mayor, and members of the Naga City Council.

zh.t: 2001年南甘马粦省纳加地方选举
zh.s: 2001年5月14日，南甘马粦省纳加市举行地方选举，这是2001年菲律宾大选的一部分。选民选出市长、副市长和纳加市议会议员。

en.s: Local elections was held in the City of Manila on May 14, 2001, within the Philippine general election. The voters elected for the elective local posts in the city: the mayor, vice mayor, the six Congressmen, and the councilors, six in each of the city's six legislative districts.

en.s: General elections were held in Sierra Leone on 14 May 2002 to elect a president and parliament. Both votes were won by the Sierra Leone People's Party, whose leader, Ahmed Tejan Kabbah, was re-elected as President. 2,342,547 voters were registered for the election. The United Nations Mission in Sierra Leone was authorised, under Security Council Resolution 1389 (2002), to assist in the electoral process.

zh.s: 塞拉利昂于2002年5月14日举行大选，选出总统和议会议员。塞拉利昂人民党赢得两项选举，其领袖艾哈迈德·泰詹·卡巴再次当选总统。登记选民共有2,342,547人。根据联合国安理会第1389号决议，联合国塞拉利昂特派团获授权协助选举进程。

en.s: The 2002 election for Mayor of Newark took place in Newark, the most populous city in the state of New Jersey, on May 14, 2002. Elections for all seats on the nine-member Municipal Council of Newark were held the same day. A runoff election, if necessary, would have taken place. Elections in the city are non-partisan and candidates are not listed by political party.

zh.s: 2002年纽瓦克市长选举于5月14日举行。纽瓦克是新泽西州人口最多的城市。市议会九个席位也在同一天改选。如有必要，还会举行第二轮投票。该市选举不分党派，候选人名单不标注政党。

en.s: The 56th Cannes Film Festival took place from 14 to 25 May 2003. French opera and theatre director, filmmaker, actor and producer Patrice Chéreau was the President of the Jury for the main competition. Monica Bellucci hosted the opening and closing ceremonies. American filmmaker Gus Van Sant won the Palme d'Or, the festival's top prize, for the drama film Elephant, based on the Columbine High School massacre.

en.s: Rico Linhas Aéreas Flight 4815 was a domestic scheduled passenger flight from São Paulo de Olivença, via Tefé, to Manaus, the capital of Amazonas state, northwest Brazil. On 14 May 2004, the aircraft operating the flight, an Embraer EMB 120 Brasilia, crashed into the dense Amazon rainforest while on approach to Manaus. All 33 people on board were killed.

zh.s: Rico Linhas Aéreas 4815号航班是巴西国内定期客运航班，从圣保罗-迪奥利文萨出发，经特费飞往亚马孙州首府马瑙斯。2004年5月14日，执飞航班的巴西航空工业公司EMB 120“巴西利亚”飞机在马瑙斯进场时坠入亚马孙雨林，机上33人全部遇难。

en.s: An election for the National Assembly took place in Taiwan on Saturday, 14 May 2005, from 07:30 to 16:00 local time. It elected an ad hoc National Assembly whose only function was to serve as a constituent assembly in order to approve or reject amendments to the Constitution of the Republic of China already proposed by the Legislative Yuan.

zh.s: 2005年5月14日（星期六）当地时间7时30分至16时，台湾举行国民大会选举。选出的临时国民大会只有一项职能：作为制宪会议，对立法院已经提出的《中华民国宪法》修正案作出批准或否决。

en.s: The 2005 Football Conference play-off final took place on 14 May 2005 and was contested between Stevenage Borough and Carlisle United. It was held at the Britannia Stadium, Stoke and had an attendance of 13,422.

zh.t: 2005年足球议会全国联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2005年足球议会全国联赛升级附加赛决赛于2005年5月14日举行，由史蒂夫尼奇自治市队对阵卡莱尔联队。比赛在斯托克的不列颠尼亚球场举行，现场观众13,422人。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Comoros on 16 April and 14 May 2006. As it was the turn of the island of Anjouan to hold the union presidency, a primary election was held in Anjouan on 16 April, prior to a national election on 14 May. The result was a victory for Ahmed Abdallah Mohamed Sambi, who received 58% of the vote in the national election.

zh.s: 科摩罗总统选举于2006年4月16日和5月14日举行。按照轮值安排，昂儒昂岛当年负责产生联盟总统，因此4月16日在昂儒昂岛先举行初选，5月14日再举行全国选举。全国选举中，艾哈迈德·阿卜杜拉·穆罕默德·桑比以58%的得票率获胜。

en.s: The 2006 FA Trophy Final, was the final match of the 2005-06 FA Trophy. It was the 37th season of the competition for teams from the Conference and other semi-professional teams below this level. The match was held on Sunday 14 May 2006 at Boleyn Ground, London, and was contested by Grays Athletic and Woking. Both sides had won all their previous appearances in the FA Trophy Final.

zh.s: 2006年英格兰足总锦标赛决赛是2005—06赛季赛事的最后一场比赛，也是该赛事第37个赛季。赛事面向英格兰足球议会联赛及更低级别的其他半职业球队。决赛于2006年5月14日星期日在伦敦厄普顿公园球场举行，由格雷斯竞技对阵沃金。两队此前都曾参加过足总锦标赛决赛，且均保持全胜。

en.s: The 2006 Taça de Portugal final was the final match of the 2005–06 Taça de Portugal, the 66th season of the Taça de Portugal, the premier Portuguese football cup competition organized by the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF). The match was played on 14 May 2006 at the Estádio Nacional in Oeiras, and opposed two Primeira Liga sides: Porto and Vitória de Setúbal.

zh.s: 2006年葡萄牙杯决赛是2005—06赛季该项赛事的决赛，也是葡萄牙顶级足球杯赛葡萄牙杯的第66个赛季。比赛由葡萄牙足球协会主办，于2006年5月14日在奥埃拉什的国家体育场举行，对阵双方是葡超球队波尔图和塞图巴尔胜利。

en.s: Election to the Senate of the Philippines was held on Monday, May 14, 2007. This is to elect 12 of the 24 seats in the Senate. Together with those elected in 2004, they will comprise the 14th Congress via plurality-at-large voting. The senators elected in 2004 will serve until June 30, 2010, while the senators elected in this election will serve up to June 30, 2013. The elections to the House of Representatives as well as local elections occurred on the same date. The Philippines uses plurality-at-large voting for seats in the Senate.

zh.s: 菲律宾于2007年5月14日（星期一）举行参议院选举，改选24个席位中的12席。与2004年选出的参议员共同组成第14届国会。本次当选参议员的任期至2013年6月30日；2004年当选者的任期至2010年6月30日。众议院和地方选举也在同日举行。菲律宾参议院选举采用全体选民投票、按得票数决定多个席位归属的制度。

en.s: Legislative and local elections were held in the Philippines on May 14, 2007. Positions contested included half the seats in the Senate, which are elected for six-year terms, and all the seats in the House of Representatives, who were elected for three-year terms. The duly elected legislators of the 2007 elections joined the elected senators of the 2004 elections to comprise the 14th Congress of the Philippines. Most representatives won seats by being elected directly, the constituency being a geographical district of about 250,000 voters. There are 220 seats in total for all the legislative districts.

zh.s: 菲律宾于2007年5月14日举行立法和地方选举。改选职位包括任期6年的参议院半数席位和任期3年的众议院全部席位。2007年当选的立法者与2004年当选的参议员共同组成第14届菲律宾国会。众议院共有220个地理选区席位，各选区大约有25万名选民，多数议员由选区选民直接选出。

en.s: Gubernatorial elections were held in the Philippines on May 14, 2007. All provinces elected their provincial governors for three-year terms that will begin on June 30, 2007. Governors that are currently serving their third consecutive terms are prohibited from running as governors (they may run in any other position).

zh.s: 2007年5月14日，菲律宾举行省长选举，各省选出任期三年的省长，新任期于6月30日开始。已连续担任三届省长的人不得竞选省长，但可以竞选其他职位。

en.s: Local elections were held in Las Piñas on May 14, 2007, within the Philippine general election. The voters elected for the elective local posts in the city: the mayor, vice mayor, one representative, and the councilors, six in each of the city's two legislative districts.

zh.s: 2007年5月14日，拉斯皮尼亚斯举行地方选举，这是菲律宾大选的一部分。选民选出市长、副市长、一名众议员，以及两个市议会选区各六名议员。

en.s: Local elections were held in the Makati on May 14, 2007, within the 2007 Philippine general election. The voters elected for the elective local posts in the city: the mayor, vice mayor, two district representatives, and councilors, eight in each of the city's two legislative districts.

zh.s: 2007年5月14日，马卡蒂举行地方选举，这是2007年菲律宾大选的一部分。选民选出市长、副市长、两个选区各一名众议员，以及两个市议会选区各八名议员。

en.s: Local elections were held in Cebu City on May 14, 2007, within the Philippine general election. Registered voters of the city elected candidates for the following elective local posts: mayor, vice mayor, district representatives, and eight councilors for each district. There are two legislative districts in the city.

zh.s: 2007年5月14日，宿务市举行地方选举，这是菲律宾大选的一部分。该市登记选民选出市长、副市长、各区众议员，以及每个选区的八名市议员。宿务市有两个众议院选区。

en.s: Local elections were held in Pasay on May 14, 2007, within the Philippine general election. The voters elected for the elective local posts in the city: the mayor, vice mayor, the representative for the lone district, and the councilors, six of them in the two districts of the city.

zh.s: 2007年5月14日，帕赛举行地方选举，这是菲律宾大选的一部分。选民选出市长、副市长、该市单一选区的众议员，以及市内两个选区共六名市议员。

en.s: Local elections were held in Calamba, Laguna, on May 14, 2007, within the Philippine general election, for posts of the mayor, vice mayor and ten councillors.

zh.s: 2007年5月14日，菲律宾拉古纳省卡兰巴举行地方选举，选出市长、副市长和十名市议员。

en.s: Local elections were held in the Province of Laguna on May 14, 2007 as part of the 2007 Philippine general election. Voters selected candidates for all local positions: a municipal/city mayor, vice mayor and town councilors, as well as members of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, the vice-governor, governor and representatives for the four districts of Laguna.

zh.s: 2007年5月14日，菲律宾拉古纳省举行地方选举，这是2007年菲律宾大选的一部分。选民选出市镇或城市的市长、副市长和市议员，以及省议会议员、副省长、省长和拉古纳省四个选区的众议员。

en.s: Local elections were held in the province of Davao del Norte on May 14, 2007, as part of the 2007 general election. The voters elected candidates for all local positions: a town mayor, vice mayor and town councilors, as well as members of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, the vice-governor, governor and representatives for the two districts of Davao del Norte.

zh.s: 2007年5月14日，菲律宾北达沃省举行地方选举，这是2007年大选的一部分。选民选出市镇的市长、副市长和市议员，以及省议会议员、副省长、省长和北达沃省两个选区的众议员。

en.s: Local elections were held in Davao City on May 14, 2007, within the Philippine general election. The voters elected for the elective local posts in the city: the mayor, vice mayor, three representatives, and twenty-four councilors, eight per district.

zh.s: 2007年5月14日，达沃市举行地方选举，这是菲律宾大选的一部分。选民选出市长、副市长、三名众议员和24名市议员，每个选区各选出八人。

en.s: Local elections were held in Naga City, Camarines Sur, on May 14, 2007, as part of the 2007 Philippine general election. Voters elected a mayor, vice mayor, ten members of the Naga City Council, and one member of the House of Representatives of the Philippines.

zh.t: 2007年南甘马粦省纳加地方选举
zh.s: 2007年5月14日，南甘马粦省纳加市举行地方选举，这是2007年菲律宾大选的一部分。选民选出市长、副市长、十名纳加市议会议员，以及一名菲律宾众议院议员。

en.s: Local elections was held in the province of Batangas on May 14, 2007, as part of the 2007 Philippine general election. Voters will select candidates for all local positions: a town mayor, vice mayor and town councilors, as well as members of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, the vice-governor, governor and representatives for the four districts of Batangas. The list below are the candidates as of May 2007.

zh.s: 2007年5月14日，菲律宾八打雁省举行地方选举，这是2007年菲律宾大选的一部分。选民将选出市镇的市长、副市长和市议员，以及省议会议员、副省长、省长和八打雁省四个选区的众议员。以下名单列出截至2007年5月的候选人。

en.s: Local elections were held in the city of Valenzuela on May 14, 2007, within the Philippine general election. The voters voted for the elective local posts in the city: the mayor, vice mayor, two Congressmen, and the councilors—six in each of the city's two legislative districts.

zh.s: 2007年5月14日，巴伦苏埃拉市举行地方选举，这是菲律宾大选的一部分。选民选出市长、副市长、两名众议员，以及该市两个众议院选区各六名市议员。

en.s: Local elections was held in the City of Manila on May 14, 2007, within the Philippine general election. The voters elected for the elective local posts in the city: the mayor, vice mayor, the six Congressmen, and the councilors, six in each of the city's six legislative districts.

zh.s: 2007年5月14日，马尼拉市举行地方选举，这是菲律宾大选的一部分。选民选出市长、副市长、六名众议员，以及该市六个众议院选区各六名市议员。

en.s: Local elections was held in Zamboanga City on May 14, 2007, within the Philippine general election. The voters elected for the elective local posts in the city: the mayor, vice mayor, and eight councilors per district. Previously, the city voters elected 12 councilors and one representative from its lone district.

zh.s: 2007年5月14日，三宝颜市举行地方选举，这是菲律宾大选的一部分。选民选出市长、副市长和每个选区各八名市议员。此前，该市选民曾从唯一的选区选出12名市议员和一名众议员。

en.s: The 2008 UEFA Cup final was a football match that took place on 14 May 2008 at the City of Manchester Stadium in Manchester, England. It was the 37th annual final of the UEFA Cup, UEFA's second tier club football tournament.

zh.s: 2008年欧洲联盟杯决赛于2008年5月14日在英格兰曼彻斯特的曼彻斯特市球场举行。这场足球赛是欧洲联盟杯第37届决赛；欧洲联盟杯是欧洲足联旗下第二级别的俱乐部赛事。

en.s: The 2008 Bulgarian Cup final was the 68th final of the Bulgarian Cup, and was contested between Cherno More Varna and Litex Lovech on 14 May 2008 at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia. Litex won the final 1–0, through a Stanislav Manolev goal in the 58th minute, claiming their third Bulgarian Cup title.

zh.s: 2008年保加利亚杯决赛是该赛事第68届决赛，于2008年5月14日在索非亚的瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场举行，由瓦尔纳切尔诺莫雷对阵洛维奇利特克斯。利特克斯凭借斯坦尼斯拉夫·马诺列夫第58分钟的进球，以1比0获胜，第三次夺得保加利亚杯冠军。

en.s: The 61st Annual Cannes Film Festival took place from 14 to 25 May 2008. American actor and filmmaker Sean Penn served as jury president for the main competition. French filmmaker Laurent Cantet won the Palme d'Or, the festival's top prize, for the drama film The Class. The festival opened with Blindness by Fernando Meirelles and closed with What Just Happened by Barry Levinson.

en.s: The 2009 El Paso mayoral election was held on May 14, 2009, to elect the mayor of El Paso, Texas. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor John Cook. No runoff was required, as Cook secured a majority of the vote in the initial round.

zh.s: 2009年埃尔帕索市长选举于2009年5月14日举行。时任市长约翰·库克成功连任。库克在首轮投票中获得过半数选票，因此无需举行第二轮投票。

en.s: A by-election was held in the Faleata West constituency in Samoa on 14 May 2010. The by-election was precipitated by the disqualification from the Legislative Assembly of Lealailepule Rimoni Aiafi for joining the Tautua Samoa Party. It was won by the Human Rights Protection Party's Ale Vena Ale.

zh.s: 萨摩亚法莱阿塔西区于2010年5月14日举行补选。时任议员莱阿莱莱普莱·里莫尼·艾亚菲因加入萨摩亚关怀党而被取消议员资格，因而触发补选。人权保护党候选人阿莱·维纳·阿莱获胜。

en.s: The 2010 Liga Panameña de Fútbol Clausura Final was the final match of the 2010 Liga Panameña de Fútbol Clausura, the 26th season of the top league competition in Panamanian football.

en.s: The Dallas mayoral election of 2011 took place on May 14, 2011, to elect the successor to incumbent Mayor Tom Leppert. Leppert decided not to run for a second term, deciding to instead run for United States Senate in 2012. The race is officially nonpartisan. After no candidate received a majority of the votes, the top two candidates - Mike Rawlings and David Kunkle - faced each other in a runoff election on June 18, 2011 in which Rawlings prevailed.

zh.s: 达拉斯于2011年5月14日举行市长选举，为时任市长汤姆·莱珀特选出继任者。莱珀特决定不竞选第二个任期，转而计划参加2012年美国参议院选举。该选举在形式上不按党派划分。由于没有候选人获得过半选票，得票最高的两人迈克·罗林斯和戴维·昆克尔进入6月18日的决选，罗林斯最终胜出。

en.s: The 2011 Fort Worth mayoral election was held on May 14, 2011 to elect the next mayor of Fort Worth, Texas. The incumbent mayor Mike Moncrief did not seek reelection after having served four terms as mayor of Fort Worth since 2003. Republican Betsy Price won the election against Democrat Jim Lane and succeeded Moncrief on July 12, 2011.

zh.s: 沃思堡于2011年5月14日举行市长选举。时任市长迈克·蒙克里夫自2003年起担任市长，已连任四届，没有寻求连任。共和党人贝齐·普莱斯击败民主党人吉姆·莱恩当选，并于2011年7月12日接任市长。

en.s: Jewels 13th Ring and Jewels 14th Ring are two mixed martial arts (MMA) events combined in a single date and location held by promotion Jewels. The events took place on May 14, 2011 at Shin-Kiba 1st Ring in Koto, Tokyo, Japan.

zh.s: 日本女子综合格斗推广组织Jewels将第13场和第14场赛事合并为同日、同地点举行的两场比赛。赛事于2011年5月14日在日本东京江东区的新木场第一会馆举行。

en.s: The 2011 FA Cup final was the 130th final of the FA Cup, the world's oldest domestic football cup competition. The final took place on 14 May 2011 at Wembley Stadium in London in front of 88,643 spectators and a British television audience of more than eight million. The clubs contesting the final were Premier League clubs Manchester City and Stoke City.

zh.s: 2011年英格兰足总杯决赛是该赛事第130届决赛。足总杯是世界上历史最悠久的国内足球杯赛。决赛于2011年5月14日在伦敦温布利球场举行，现场观众88,643人，英国电视观众超过800万。对阵双方是英超球队曼彻斯特城和斯托克城。

en.s: On May 14, 2011, the city of San Antonio, Texas held an election to choose who would serve as Mayor of San Antonio for a two-year term to expire in 2013. Julian Castro, the incumbent Mayor, was re-elected with over 81% of the vote, earning a second term. The election was officially nonpartisan as prescribed by Texas law.

zh.s: 2011年5月14日，得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥举行市长选举，选出任期至2013年的市长。时任市长朱利安·卡斯特罗以超过81%的得票率连任，开始第二个任期。根据得克萨斯州法律，这场选举不设党派。

en.s: The 2011 Coupe de France final was the 93rd final of France's most prestigious football cup competition. The final took place on 14 May 2011 at the Stade de France in Saint-Denis and was contested between Paris Saint-Germain and Lille. Paris Saint-Germain were the defending champions of the competition and it was the third time in the club's history that it had appeared in back-to-back finals.

zh.s: 2011年法国杯决赛是法国最重要的足球杯赛第93届决赛，于2011年5月14日在圣但尼法兰西体育场举行，由巴黎圣日耳曼对阵里尔。巴黎圣日耳曼是卫冕冠军；这是该俱乐部历史上第三次连续两年闯入决赛。

en.s: The Battle of Rastan between the Syrian Armed Forces and the Free Syrian Army took place in the city of Rastan on 14 May 2012, during the U.N. brokered cease-fire of the conflict.

zh.s: 2012年5月14日，叙利亚政府军与叙利亚自由军在拉斯坦市交战。当时，冲突双方正处于联合国斡旋的停火期间。

en.s: The siege of Northern Homs was a siege lasting six years, by the Syrian government in the northern part of the Homs Governorate during the Syrian civil war, as a result of the rebel capture of Rastan and surrounding areas in 2012, the rebel-held pocket in northern Homs was fully taken by the Syrian government in 2018 after clearing opposition held areas around the capital.

zh.s: 叙利亚政府在叙利亚内战期间围困霍姆斯省北部地区长达六年。2012年，反政府武装攻占拉斯坦及周边地区后，在霍姆斯省北部形成一块由反政府武装控制的区域。2018年，政府军清除首都周边的反对派控制区后，全面夺回了这片区域。

en.t: Agni Air Flight CHT crashes in Nepal after a failed go-around, killing 15 people
en.s: On 14 May 2012, a Dornier 228 passenger aircraft of Agni Air operating Flight CHT, crashed near Jomsom Airport, Nepal, killing 15 of the 21 people on board, including both pilots and Indian child actress Taruni Sachdev and her mother.

zh.t: 阿格尼航空CHT航班在尼泊尔复飞失败后坠毁，造成15人死亡
zh.s: 2012年5月14日，阿格尼航空一架执行CHT航班的多尼尔228客机在尼泊尔乔姆索姆机场附近坠毁。机上21人中有15人遇难，包括两名飞行员、印度童星塔鲁尼·萨克德夫及其母亲。

en.s: Mayoral elections were held in Jersey City, New Jersey on May 14, 2013. Incumbent Democratic Mayor Jeramiah Healy lost to City Councilman Steven Fulop, also of the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 新泽西州泽西市于2013年5月14日举行市长选举。寻求连任的民主党籍市长杰里迈亚·希利败给同为民主党人的市议员史蒂文·富洛普。

en.s: The 2013 British Columbia general election took place on May 14, 2013, to elect the 85 members of the 40th Parliament of British Columbia to the Legislative Assembly in the Canadian province of British Columbia. The British Columbia Liberal Party (BC Liberals) formed the government during the 39th Parliament prior to this general election, initially under the leadership of Premier Gordon Campbell then after his resignation, Christy Clark.

zh.s: 2013年不列颠哥伦比亚省大选于2013年5月14日举行，选出该省第40届议会的85名议员。大选前，不列颠哥伦比亚自由党在第39届议会执政，最初由省长戈登·坎贝尔领导；坎贝尔辞职后，改由克里斯蒂·克拉克领导。

en.s: The 2013 Omaha mayoral election took place on May 14, 2013. Incumbent Mayor Jim Suttle sought a second term in office. The position of mayor in Omaha is officially a non-partisan position. A blanket primary was held on April 2, 2013. The top two finishers in the primary, Suttle and City Councilwoman Jean Stothert, moved on to the general election.

zh.s: 2013年奥马哈市长选举于2013年5月14日举行。时任市长吉姆·萨特尔竞选连任。奥马哈市长职位依法不分党派。此前，4月2日举行了无党派初选，得票前两名——萨特尔和市议员珍·斯托瑟特——进入大选。

en.s: The 2014 UEFA Europa League final was the final match of the 2013–14 UEFA Europa League, the 43rd season of Europe's secondary club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the fifth season since it was renamed from the UEFA Cup to the UEFA Europa League. It was played at the Juventus Stadium in Turin, Italy on 14 May 2014, between Spanish side Sevilla and Portuguese side Benfica.

zh.s: 2014年欧洲足联欧洲联赛决赛是2013—14赛季该赛事的决赛，也是欧洲足联主办的欧洲第二级别俱乐部赛事第43个赛季的收官战。这是赛事从欧洲联盟杯更名为欧洲联赛后的第5个赛季。决赛于2014年5月14日在意大利都灵的尤文图斯球场举行，由西班牙塞维利亚对阵葡萄牙本菲卡。

en.s: The Chibok ambush was an attack of Boko Haram insurgents against a Nigerian Army convoy in the night from 13 to 14 May 2014, as the latter was searching for schoolgirls who had been kidnapped by the Islamist rebels. Even though the Nigerian Army forces managed to extricate themselves from the ambush, the attack seriously affected the morale of the involved soldiers who felt that their leadership was carelessly sacrificing them in the war against the insurgents.

zh.s: 2014年5月13日至14日夜间，博科圣地武装分子袭击了一支尼日利亚陆军车队。当时，车队正在搜寻被伊斯兰主义武装分子绑架的女学生。尼军虽然成功脱离伏击，但参战士兵认为领导层在与叛乱分子的战争中不顾他们的安危，袭击严重打击了他们的士气。

en.s: Vice presidential elections were held in Guatemala on 14 May 2015. Baldetti resigned from her post as vice president on May 8, 2015, after a U.N. anti-corruption investigation arrested 24 individuals, including her personal secretary Juan Carlos Monzón Rojas, for involvement in an import bribery scheme known as La Línea (the Line) in which officials received bribes to reduce duties paid by importers.

zh.s: 2015年5月14日，危地马拉举行副总统选举。副总统巴尔德蒂于5月8日辞职。此前，联合国反腐调查逮捕了24人，其中包括她的私人秘书胡安·卡洛斯·蒙松·罗哈斯。他们涉嫌参与名为“拉利内阿”（La Línea）的进口行贿案，官员收受贿赂，为进口商降低关税。

en.s: The 2015 UEFA Women's Champions League final was the final match of the 2014–15 UEFA Women's Champions League, the 14th season of the UEFA Women's Champions League football tournament and the sixth since it was renamed from the UEFA Women's Cup. The match was played at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn-Sportpark in Berlin on 14 May 2015. Frankfurt won the match 2–1 against Paris Saint-Germain.

zh.s: 2015年欧洲女子冠军联赛决赛是2014—15赛季该赛事的决赛，也是欧洲女子冠军联赛第14个赛季、赛事从欧洲女子联盟杯更名后的第6个赛季。比赛于2015年5月14日在柏林的弗里德里希-路德维希-雅恩体育公园举行。法兰克福以2比1击败巴黎圣日耳曼。

en.s: The thirty-fourth government of Israel, (Hebrew:ממשלת ישראל השלושים וארבע) also known as the Fourth Netanyahu Government, was the government of Israel, headed by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu between 2015 and 2020. It was formed after the March 2015 Knesset election. The coalition that made up the government, consisting of Likud, United Torah Judaism, Shas, Kulanu and the Jewish Home, was submitted to the President of Israel just before the deadline on 6 May 2015.

zh.t: 以色列第三十四届政府成立
zh.s: 以色列第三十四届政府（希伯来语：ממשלת ישראל השלושים וארבע），又称内塔尼亚胡第四届政府，由总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡领导，执政时间为2015年至2020年。该政府在2015年3月议会选举后组建。由利库德集团、联合妥拉犹太教、沙斯党、库拉努党和犹太人家园党组成的执政联盟于2015年5月6日、截止日期前不久提交给以色列总统。

en.s: The 2016 Women's FA Cup final was the 46th final of the Women's FA Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was the 23rd to be played directly under the auspices of the Football Association (FA) and was named the SSE Women's FA Cup Final for sponsorship reasons. The final was contested between Arsenal Ladies and Chelsea Ladies on 14 May 2016 at Wembley Stadium in London.

zh.s: 2016年英格兰女子足总杯决赛是该赛事第46届决赛。女子足总杯是英格兰女子足球的主要杯赛。这是英格兰足总直接主办的第23届决赛；因赞助原因，赛事冠名为SSE女子足总杯决赛。决赛于2016年5月14日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由阿森纳女队对阵切尔西女队。

en.s: The 2016 European Rugby Champions Cup Final was the final match in the 2015–16 European Rugby Champions Cup, and the twenty-first European club rugby final in general. It was contested by French side Racing 92, and Saracens of England, at the Grand Stade de Lyon, in the Lyon suburb of Décines, France, on Saturday 14 May 2016. Saracens defeated Racing 92 by 21 points to 9.

zh.s: 2016年欧洲橄榄球冠军杯决赛是2015—16赛季该赛事的决赛，也是欧洲俱乐部橄榄球第21届决赛。比赛于2016年5月14日星期六在法国里昂近郊代西讷的里昂大球场举行，由法国竞技92队对阵英格兰萨拉森人队。萨拉森人以21比9获胜。

en.s: The 2016 Malaysia FA Cup final was the 27th final of the Malaysia FA Cup, the Malaysia football cup competition. Johor Darul Ta'zim F.C. assured a place for the 2017 AFC Cup group stage.

zh.s: 2016年马来西亚足总杯决赛是该项赛事第27届决赛。柔佛达鲁达格敬俱乐部因此获得2017年亚足联杯小组赛的参赛资格。

en.t: 2016 Communist Party of Bohemia and Moravia leadership election
en.s: The Communist Party of Bohemia and Moravia (KSČM) held a leadership election in May 2016. Incumbent Vojtěch Filip sought re-election. Other candidates included Josef Skála and Ivan Hrůza. Hrůza suspended his candidature before the voting started and endorsed Skála. Skála was considered the candidate of radical members of KSČM. Filip won the election and was elected for another four years.

zh.t: 2016年波希米亚和摩拉维亚共产党领导人选举
zh.s: 波希米亚和摩拉维亚共产党（KSČM）于2016年5月举行领导人选举。时任党主席沃伊捷赫·菲利普竞选连任，其他候选人包括约瑟夫·斯卡拉和伊万·赫鲁扎。投票开始前，赫鲁扎退出竞选并支持斯卡拉。斯卡拉被视为党内激进派的候选人。菲利普赢得选举，再次当选，任期四年。

en.s: Yerevan City Council elections were held on 14 May 2017. The Republican Party of Armenia won 71.25% of the total vote, the Way Out Alliance won 21%, while Yerkir Tsirani won 7.75%. Following the elections, Yerevan City Council elected Taron Margaryan as Mayor of Yerevan.

zh.s: 埃里温市议会选举于2017年5月14日举行。亚美尼亚共和党获得71.25%的总票数，“出路联盟”获得21%，亚美尼亚大地党获得7.75%。选举后，市议会选出塔龙·马尔加良担任埃里温市长。

en.s: The 2017 Lega Nord leadership election took place on 14 May 2017.

zh.s: 2017年北方联盟领导人选举于2017年5月14日举行。

en.s: The Rey del Ring (2017) show (Spanish for "King of the Ring") was a major annual lucha libre event produced and scripted by Mexican professional wrestling promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG), and took place on May 14, 2017 in Arena Naucalpan, Naucalpan, State of Mexico, Mexico. The main event was the Eponymous IWRG Rey del Ring tournament, the fifteenth annual version of the tournament, IWRG's version of WWE's Royal Rumble, multi-man elimination event.

zh.s: 2017年“擂台之王”（Rey del Ring，西班牙语意为“擂台之王”）是墨西哥职业摔角联盟国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）制作并编排的年度大型自由式摔角赛事，于2017年5月14日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。主赛是同名的IWRG“擂台之王”锦标赛，这是该赛事第15届，也是IWRG版的多选手淘汰赛，形式类似WWE的皇家大战。

en.s: Municipal election for Lalitpur, the third largest city in Nepal, was held on May 14, 2017 for the post of Mayor, Deputy Mayor, Ward Chairmen and Ward Members. All posts were elected by First past the post method; with all having a tenure of 5 years.

zh.s: 尼泊尔第三大城市拉利特布尔于2017年5月14日举行市政选举，选出市长、副市长、各区区长和区议员。所有职位均采用简单多数制选出，任期五年。

en.s: The 2017 North Rhine-Westphalia state election was held on 14 May 2017 to elect the members of the Landtag of North Rhine-Westphalia. The incumbent coalition government of the Social Democratic Party (SPD) and The Greens led by Minister-President Hannelore Kraft was defeated. The Christian Democratic Union (CDU) became the largest party and formed a coalition with the Free Democratic Party (FDP).

zh.t: 2017年北莱茵-威斯特法伦州选举
zh.s: 2017年北莱茵-威斯特法伦州选举于5月14日举行，选出该州州议会议员。由州长汉内洛蕾·克拉夫特领导、由德国社会民主党和绿党组成的现任联合政府落败。基督教民主联盟成为最大党，并与自由民主党组成联合政府。

en.s: The 2017 National League play-off final, known as the Vanarama National League Promotion Final for sponsorship reasons, was held on 14 May 2017 at Wembley Stadium and contested between Forest Green Rovers and Tranmere Rovers at the end of the 2016–17 National League season. It was the 15th National League play-off final, the second under the name National League and the tenth to be played at Wembley.

zh.t: 2017年全国联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2017年全国联赛升级附加赛决赛因赞助原因称为Vanarama全国联赛升级决赛，于2017年5月14日在温布利球场举行，由森林绿流浪者对阵特兰米尔流浪者，作为2016—17赛季全国联赛的收官赛。这是全国联赛升级附加赛第15届决赛，也是赛事更名为全国联赛后的第二届、在温布利举行的第十届。

en.s: The 2017 Nepalese local elections were held in Nepal in three phases on 14 May, 28 June and 18 September in 6 metropolitan cities, 11 sub-metropolitan cities, 276 municipalities and 460 rural municipalities. It was the first local level election to be held since the promulgation of the 2015 constitution.

en.t: 2018 Philippine barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan elections
en.s: Barangay elections in the Philippines were held on May 14, 2018. The election elected the Punong Barangay, more commonly known as barangay captains, and members of the Sangguniang Barangay, or barangay council, in 41,948 barangays (villages) throughout the country whose terms start on June 30, 2018. Barangays are the smallest local government unit in the Philippines. Elections for the reformed Sangguniang Kabataan (SK; youth councils) were also held at the same time.

zh.t: 2018年菲律宾村社及青年议会选举
zh.s: 2018年5月14日，菲律宾举行村社选举，选出全国41,948个村社的村长（Punong Barangay，通常称barangay captains）和村社议会议员（Sangguniang Barangay）。新任期于2018年6月30日开始。村社是菲律宾最基层的地方行政单位。同日还举行了改革后的青年议会（Sangguniang Kabataan，简称SK）选举。

en.s: Panchayat elections were held in the Indian state of West Bengal in May 2018. The polls were hit with widespread violence throughout the state. The ruling All India Trinamool Congress won 1/3 of the total electoral seats uncontested, although there were widespread instances of TMC cadres using violence to prevent candidates of the Opposition from filing their nominations.

zh.s: 2018年5月，印度西孟加拉邦举行乡村地方选举。全邦多地发生严重暴力事件。执政的全印度草根国大党有三分之一的选区无人竞争、直接当选。与此同时，该党干部多次使用暴力，阻止反对派候选人提交提名。

en.s: On May 14, 2019, jihadists from Islamic State in the Greater Sahara (ISGS) attacked Nigerien forces in Baley Beri, Niger, killing twenty-seven Nigerien soldiers.

zh.s: 2019年5月14日，大撒哈拉伊斯兰国武装分子在尼日尔巴莱贝里袭击尼日尔军队，造成27名士兵死亡。

en.s: The 2019 North Miami mayoral election took place on May 14, 2019. Incumbent Mayor Smith Joseph was term-limited and unable to seek re-election to a third term. Four candidates ran to succeed him: Vice Mayor Philippe Bien-Aime; Mac-Kinley Lauriston, the chief of staff to County Commissioner Jean Monestime; former mayoral candidate Danielle Beauvais, and retired physician Hector Medina.

zh.s: 2019年北迈阿密市长选举于5月14日举行。时任市长史密斯·约瑟夫已达任期上限，不能竞选第三个任期。四名候选人角逐接替他：副市长菲利普·比安-艾梅；县委员让·莫内斯蒂姆的幕僚长麦克-金利·劳里斯顿；曾参选市长的丹妮尔·博韦；以及退休医生赫克托·梅迪纳。

en.t: May 2021 Democratic Unionist Party leadership election
en.s: The May 2021 Democratic Unionist Party leadership election was triggered by Arlene Foster's resignation from leadership. It was the Democratic Unionist Party's first leadership election since the party's founding in 1971. Foster released a statement on 28 April 2021 announcing her intention to resign as party leader on 28 May in order to provide party officers with some space to arrange for the leadership contest.

zh.s: 2021年5月民主统一党党魁选举因阿琳·福斯特辞去党魁职务而举行。这是该党自1971年成立以来首次举行党魁选举。福斯特于2021年4月28日发表声明，表示将于5月28日辞去党魁职务，以便党内工作人员有时间安排选举。

en.s: On May 14, 2022, a mass shooting occurred in Buffalo, New York, United States, at a Tops Friendly Markets supermarket in the East Side neighborhood. Ten people, all of whom were black, were murdered, and three people were injured. The perpetrator, 18-year-old Payton Gendron, livestreamed part of the attack on Twitch until the livestream was shut down by the service in under two minutes.

zh.s: 2022年5月14日，美国纽约州布法罗市东区一家Tops Friendly Markets超市发生大规模枪击案。10人遇害，3人受伤，遇害者均为黑人。18岁的枪手佩顿·金德龙在Twitch上直播了部分袭击过程，平台不到两分钟便关闭了直播。

en.s: The 2022 FA Cup final was an association football match played at Wembley Stadium in London, England, on 14 May 2022. Chelsea and Liverpool were the finalists, the same as in the 2022 EFL Cup final earlier in the season. This was the first time that the same pair of teams met in both the EFL Cup and FA Cup finals of the same season since Arsenal and Sheffield Wednesday in 1993.

zh.s: 2022年英格兰足总杯决赛于2022年5月14日在英格兰伦敦的温布利球场举行，由切尔西对阵利物浦。两队此前也在当赛季英格兰足球联赛杯决赛中交手。这是自1993年阿森纳与谢菲尔德星期三之后，首次有同一对球队在同一赛季同时进入联赛杯和足总杯决赛。

en.s: Capital Collision was a professional wrestling event produced by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW). It took place on May 14, 2022, at the Entertainment and Sports Arena in Washington, D.C. Wrestlers from NJPW's U.S. partner promotion All Elite Wrestling (AEW) appeared on the card. This was the first event to be held under the Capital Collision name.

zh.s: “首都碰撞”是新日本职业摔角（NJPW）举办的一场职业摔角赛事，于2022年5月14日在华盛顿特区的娱乐与体育馆举行。新日本在美国的合作联盟精英摔角（AEW）也有选手参赛。这是首场以“首都碰撞”为名的赛事。

en.t: 2022 Communist Party of Bohemia and Moravia leadership election
en.s: The Communist Party of Bohemia and Moravia (KSČM) held a leadership election on 14 May 2022. MEP Kateřina Konečná was reelected as the leader of KSČM.

zh.t: 2022年波希米亚和摩拉维亚共产党领导人选举
zh.s: 波希米亚和摩拉维亚共产党（KSČM）于2022年5月14日举行领导人选举。欧洲议会议员凯特日娜·科内奇娜再次当选党主席。

en.t: UFC on ESPN: Błachowicz vs. Rakić
en.s: UFC on ESPN: Błachowicz vs. Rakić (also known as UFC on ESPN 36 and UFC Vegas 54) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on May 14, 2022, at the UFC Apex facility in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Area, United States.

zh.t: UFC ESPN赛事：布拉霍维奇对阵拉基奇
zh.s: UFC ESPN赛事：布拉霍维奇对阵拉基奇，也称UFC ESPN 36或UFC拉斯维加斯54，是终极格斗冠军赛主办的一场综合格斗赛事，于2022年5月14日在美国内华达州恩特普赖斯的UFC Apex场馆举行。恩特普赖斯属于拉斯维加斯都会区。

en.s: The New York Indian Film Festival (NYIFF) is an annual film festival that takes place in New York City, and screens films relating to India, the Indian Diaspora, and the work of Indian filmmakers. The festival began in November 2001 and was founded by Aroon Shivdasani and the Indo-American Arts Council. About 40 films are screened, including features films, shorts, documentaries, and animated films.
en.n: This entry records the closing, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 纽约印度电影节（NYIFF）是纽约市每年举办的电影节，放映与印度、印度侨民及印度电影人作品有关的影片。电影节于2001年11月创办，由阿伦·希夫达萨尼和印美艺术委员会共同创立。每届约放映40部影片，包括剧情长片、短片、纪录片和动画片。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的结束日期。
