en.s: Local elections were held on 14 May 2023 in Albania. Mayors and municipal council seats were being elected in each of Albania's 61 municipalities.

zh.s: 2023年5月14日，阿尔巴尼亚举行地方选举，在全国61个市镇选出市长和市议会议员。

en.s: General elections were held in Thailand on 14 May 2023 to elect 500 members of the House of Representatives. The Move Forward Party, led by Pita Limjaroenrat, surprised analysts by winning the most seats, followed by fellow opposition party Pheu Thai who had won the most seats in the 2011 and 2019 elections. Turnout was a record 75.22%.

zh.s: 2023年5月14日，泰国举行大选，选出500名众议院议员。披塔·林乍伦拉领导的前进党意外赢得最多席位，另一反对党为泰党紧随其后。为泰党曾在2011年和2019年大选中赢得最多席位。本次投票率创下纪录，达到75.22%。

en.s: The 2023 Leinster Senior Football Championship final was played at Croke Park in Dublin on 14 May 2023. It was contested by Dublin and Louth. Dublin won a 13th consecutive title.

zh.t: 2023年伦斯特高级足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2023年伦斯特高级足球锦标赛决赛于2023年5月14日在都柏林克罗克公园举行，由都柏林队对阵劳斯队。都柏林队连续第13次夺冠。

en.s: The 2023 Women's FA Cup final was the 53rd final of the Women's FA Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was the 29th to be played directly under the auspices of The Football Association (FA) and was named the Vitality Women's FA Cup Final due to sponsorship reasons. The final was contested between Manchester United and Chelsea, on 14 May 2023 at Wembley Stadium in London.

zh.s: 2023年英格兰女子足总杯决赛是该赛事第53届决赛。女子足总杯是英格兰女子足球的主要杯赛。这是英格兰足总直接主办的第29届决赛；因赞助原因，赛事冠名为Vitality女子足总杯决赛。决赛于2023年5月14日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由曼联女队对阵切尔西女队。

en.s: The 2023 Bremen state election was held on 14 May 2023 to elect the 21st Bürgerschaft of Bremen. Elections to the city councils of Bremen and Bremerhaven, the two municipal entities comprising the state of Bremen, were held simultaneously. The incumbent government was a coalition of the Social Democratic Party (SPD), Alliance 90/The Greens, and The Left led by Mayor Andreas Bovenschulte.

zh.s: 2023年不来梅州选举于2023年5月14日举行，选出第21届不来梅州议会。构成不来梅州的两个市政实体——不来梅和不来梅哈芬——也在同日举行市议会选举。时任州政府由社会民主党、联盟90/绿党和左翼党组成，由市长安德烈亚斯·博文舒尔特领导。

en.s: The 2023 Gagauz gubernatorial election was held on 30 April and 14 May 2023 on the territory of the Autonomous Territorial Unit of Gagauzia, part of the Republic of Moldova. The position of Governor (Başkan) of Gagauzia represents one of the highest positions in the autonomy, also having the position of a member of the Government of the Republic of Moldova ex officio.

zh.t: 2023年加告兹自治区行政长官选举
zh.s: 2023年加告兹自治区行政长官选举于4月30日和5月14日在摩尔多瓦共和国加告兹自治区举行。行政长官（Başkan）是自治区的最高职位之一，并依法兼任摩尔多瓦共和国政府成员。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Turkey on 14 May 2023, alongside presidential elections, to elect all 600 members of the Grand National Assembly. The incoming members formed the 28th Parliament of Turkey. The elections had originally been scheduled to take place on June 18, but the government moved them forward by a month to avoid coinciding with the university exams, the Hajj pilgrimage and the start of the summer holidays.

zh.s: 土耳其于2023年5月14日举行议会选举，与总统选举同期举行，选出大国民议会全部600名议员。新当选议员组成土耳其第28届议会。选举原定于6月18日举行，政府将日期提前一个月，以避开大学考试、朝觐和暑假开始的时间。

en.s: General elections were held in Turkey on 14 May 2023, combining presidential elections and parliamentary elections to elect 600 members of the Grand National Assembly. Election monitors criticized the conduct of the elections, observing restrictions on fundamental freedoms of assembly, association and expression. There was political interference in the electoral process, threats of throttling social media platforms, arrests of people posting criticisms on social media, and fines against media organizations that criticized the government.

zh.s: 土耳其于2023年5月14日举行大选，包括总统选举和议会选举，选出大国民议会全部600名议员。选举监督人员批评选举过程，指出集会、结社和言论等基本自由受到限制。选举过程还受到政治干预；有人威胁限制社交媒体平台，批评政府的社交媒体发帖者遭逮捕，批评政府的媒体机构则被罚款。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Turkey in May 2023, alongside parliamentary elections, to elect a president for a term of five years. Dubbed the most important election of 2023, the presidential election went to a run-off for the first time in Turkish history. The election had originally been scheduled to take place on 18 June, but the government moved them forward by a month to avoid coinciding with the university exams, the Hajj pilgrimage and the start of the summer holidays.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 土耳其于2023年5月举行总统选举，与议会选举同期举行，选出任期五年的总统。这场选举被称为2023年最重要的选举，且是土耳其历史上首次进入第二轮投票。选举原定于6月18日举行，政府将日期提前一个月，以避开大学考试、朝觐和暑假开始的时间。
zh.n: 本条记录的是来源信息框所列的选举日期。

en.s: The 2024 Maryland Democratic presidential primary took place on May 14, 2024, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election, alongside two other state contests. 95 delegates to the Democratic National Convention were allocated, with 23 additional unpledged delegates. Incumbent President Joe Biden announced his bid for a second term on April 25, 2023. Biden easily won the primary.

zh.t: 2024年马里兰州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年马里兰州民主党总统初选于2024年5月14日举行，是2024年民主党总统初选的一部分，与另外两个州的初选同期举行。95名代表将出席民主党全国代表大会，另有23名非承诺代表。现任总统乔·拜登于2023年4月25日宣布竞选连任，并轻松赢得这场初选。

en.s: The 2024 Maryland Republican presidential primary was held on May 14, 2024, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 37 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a winner-take-all basis. The contest was held alongside primaries in Nebraska and West Virginia.

zh.t: 2024年马里兰州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年马里兰州共和党总统初选于2024年5月14日举行，是2024年总统选举共和党初选的一部分。37名代表将出席2024年共和党全国代表大会，按胜者全得方式分配。该州初选与内布拉斯加州和西弗吉尼亚州同期举行。

en.s: The 2024 Nebraska Republican presidential primary was held on May 14, 2024, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 36 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a winner-take-all basis. The contest was held alongside primaries in Maryland and West Virginia.

zh.t: 2024年内布拉斯加州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年内布拉斯加州共和党总统初选于2024年5月14日举行，是2024年总统选举共和党初选的一部分。36名代表将出席2024年共和党全国代表大会，按胜者全得方式分配。该州初选与马里兰州和西弗吉尼亚州同期举行。

en.s: The 2024 Nebraska Democratic presidential primary took place on May 14, 2024, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election, alongside two other state contests. 29 delegates to the Democratic National Convention were allocated in the semi-closed primary, with 5 additional unpledged delegates. Incumbent President Joe Biden announced his bid for a second term on April 25, 2023.

zh.t: 2024年内布拉斯加州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年内布拉斯加州民主党总统初选于2024年5月14日举行，是2024年民主党总统初选的一部分，与另外两个州的初选同期举行。这场半开放式初选分配29名民主党全国代表大会代表，另有5名非承诺代表。现任总统乔·拜登于2023年4月25日宣布竞选连任。

en.s: The 2024 West Virginia Democratic presidential primary took place on May 14, 2024, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election, alongside two other state primaries. 20 delegates to the Democratic National Convention were allocated in a semi-closed primary, with 5 additional unpledged delegates.

zh.t: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州民主党总统初选于2024年5月14日举行，是2024年民主党总统初选的一部分，与另外两个州的初选同期举行。这场半开放式初选分配20名民主党全国代表大会代表，另有5名非承诺代表。

en.s: The 2024 West Virginia Republican presidential primary was held on May 14, 2024, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 32 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a winner-take-all basis. The contest was held alongside the Maryland and Nebraska primaries.

zh.t: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州共和党总统初选于2024年5月14日举行，是2024年总统选举共和党初选的一部分。32名代表将出席2024年共和党全国代表大会，按胜者全得方式分配。该州初选与马里兰州和内布拉斯加州同期举行。

en.s: The 2024 Albanian Cup final was the final match of the 2023–24 edition of the Albanian Cup, and the 72nd final of Albania's premier national football cup. It was played on 14 May 2024 between Kukësi and Egnatia. Egnatia won the match 1–0 for their second consecutive and second overall Albanian Cup title.

zh.s: 2024年阿尔巴尼亚杯决赛决出了2023—24赛季该项赛事的冠军，也是阿尔巴尼亚顶级国内足球杯赛第72届决赛。比赛于2024年5月14日举行，由库克斯对阵埃格纳蒂亚。埃格纳蒂亚以1比0获胜，连续第二年夺冠，也是队史第二次夺得阿尔巴尼亚杯。

en.s: The 2024 Anchorage mayoral election was held on April 2, 2024, with a runoff election on May 14 because no candidate received more than 45% of the vote in the first round. It elected the mayor of Anchorage, Alaska. Incumbent Republican mayor Dave Bronson ran for re-election to a second term in office. Bronson and former Anchorage Assembly chair Suzanne LaFrance advanced to the runoff, with LaFrance narrowly placing ahead of Bronson.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2024年安克雷奇市长选举首轮投票于4月2日举行。由于没有候选人得票超过45%，5月14日举行第二轮投票，选出阿拉斯加州安克雷奇市长。时任共和党籍市长戴夫·布朗森竞选连任。布朗森和前安克雷奇市议会主席苏珊·拉弗朗斯进入第二轮，拉弗朗斯略微领先。
zh.n: 本条记录的是来源信息框所列的第二轮选举日期。

en.s: The 2025 Magyar Kupa final decided the winners of the 2024–25 Magyar Kupa, the 85th season of Hungarian premier football cup, the Magyar Kupa. The match was played on 14 May 2025 at the Puskás Aréna in Budapest between Paks and Ferencváros. The final score of the match remained 1–1 after extra time, and Paks won the penalty shootout 4–3, thus winning the cup for the second time in its history.

zh.s: 2025年匈牙利杯决赛决出了2024—25赛季匈牙利杯冠军，这是该项匈牙利顶级足球杯赛的第85个赛季。决赛于2025年5月14日在布达佩斯普斯卡什竞技场举行，由保克什队对阵费伦茨瓦罗斯队。加时赛后双方仍以1比1战平，保克什队随后以4比3赢得点球大战，队史第二次夺得冠军。

en.s: The 2025 Coppa Italia final was the final match of the 2024–25 edition of the Coppa Italia, Italy's premier national football cup. It was played on 14 May 2025 between Milan and Bologna. Bologna won the match 1–0 for their third Coppa Italia title, and the first since 1974.

zh.s: 2025年意大利杯决赛决出了2024—25赛季意大利顶级国内足球杯赛冠军。比赛于2025年5月14日举行，由AC米兰对阵博洛尼亚。博洛尼亚以1比0获胜，第三次夺得意大利杯，也是自1974年以来首次夺冠。

en.s: The 2025 Ukrainian Cup final was the 32nd final match of the annual Ukrainian football cup competition. It was played on 14 May 2025 at the Tsentralnyi Stadion in Zhytomyr. This is the first time the cup final was held in Zhytomyr.

zh.s: 2025年乌克兰杯决赛是该项年度足球杯赛的第32届决赛，于2025年5月14日在日托米尔的中央球场举行。这是乌克兰杯决赛首次在日托米尔举行。

en.s: The 2025 Turkish Cup final was the decisive match of the 2024–25 Turkish Cup, the 63rd edition of Turkey's primary football cup competition organized by the Turkish Football Federation (TFF). The final was played on 14 May 2025 at Gaziantep Stadium, and featured Galatasaray and Trabzonspor. On 16 April 2025, the match was initially announced to be held at the New Eskişehir Stadium in Eskişehir.

zh.s: 2025年土耳其杯决赛决出了2024—25赛季土耳其杯冠军，这是土耳其足球协会主办的土耳其顶级足球杯赛第63届赛事。决赛于2025年5月14日在加济安泰普体育场举行，由加拉塔萨雷对阵特拉布宗体育。此前，赛事方于2025年4月16日宣布，决赛原定在埃斯基谢希尔的新埃斯基谢希尔体育场举行。
